jobs.title: Regional Account Manager, IgAN Nephrology, East Bay, CA
jobs.description:
Location: Oakland, United States Job reference: R\-258985 Date posted: 08/27/2026
**Regional Account Manager, IgAN Nephrology, East Bay, CA**


**The territory consists of: Oakland, San Jose, Monterey, and Fresno CA.**


**About the job:**The Regional Account Manager (RAM) position is within our Rare Hematology and Nephrology Franchise, a division of Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease and will focus on the launch of IgAN as a potential new indication. The RAM will be assigned a sales territory focused on academic centers, community hospital systems, physician clinics, infusion centers, and other strategic sites of care, focused on nephrology. This individual would be responsible for the growth and expansion of the IgAN indication while supporting appropriate assigned indication opportunities with key nephrology customers.


**Why Join Us?**At Alexion, we’re united by a shared purpose: to transform the lives of people affected by rare diseases. In Neurology, that purpose is personal. We connect deeply with patients and their care teams, and we work together to deliver innovative therapies that make a real difference. Here, your work means more—more impact, more growth, and more connection.


What You’ll DoAs a Regional Account Manager – Rare Nephrology, you’ll build trusted relationships with healthcare professionals across your territory. You’ll represent Alexion’s nephrology indications, helping providers understand our therapies and how they support patients with rare nephrological conditions.


Territory: Must live within the geography


**You will:**• Consistently achieve or exceed sales objectives in assigned territory • Create and maintain strategically targeted account\-specific business plans that reflect an in\-depth understanding of local market forces impacting product sales, diagnostic pathways, referral patterns, and treatment adoption.• Develop and maintain strong, in\-depth clinical, technical, and scientific knowledge across assigned indications, with emphasis on renal disease education and the needs of nephrology customers.• Demonstrate the ability to educate on the clinical approach to relevant disease states, leading to successful differential diagnosis, appropriate testing, and timely treatment of focus patient populations.• Build and maintain productive relationships with nephrologists and other key stakeholders in academic centers, community hospital systems, physician clinics, infusion centers, and related sites of care.• Collaborate closely with internal cross\-functional stakeholders, including peer RAM(s), TLL(s), SAL(s), MSL(s), FRM(s), PEM(s), Market Access, Diagnostics, and enterprise partners.• Handle customer questions and objections in a way that is consistent with product indications and sales training methodology, including the ability to compliantly triage inquiries to the appropriate partner.• Understand and demonstrate proper use of products to clinicians in hospital, clinic, and infusion center environments.• Lead the implementation of a patient\-centric partnership model that includes physicians, their staff, patients, clinics, hospitals, and relevant care partners.• Effectively utilize CRM tools to manage territory priorities, track account engagement, document sales activities, and submit required reports accurately and on time; and adopt CRM AI\-embedded tools to prioritize opportunities and optimize call execution• Effectively use AI\-driven insights for territory planning, HCP targeting, and pre\-call strategy; translate analytics into focused customer engagement and account action plans• Execute local promotional activities and programs for the assigned therapeutic areas.• Provide a high level of product expertise and customer service to all accounts.• Proactively interact with Alexion management to refine product and market initiatives based on field insights, access trends, and account needs.• Perform work in alignment with and adhering to Alexion’s Code of Ethics and Business Conduct and Alexion policies and procedures.


**What you bring:**• Bachelor’s degree.• 5 years pharmaceutical sales or equivalent experience (e.g., Biotech or Medical Device), or 5 years of experience in a medical setting.• Proven, documented track record for delivering consistent, top\-tier sales results in institutions, hospital systems, and/or complex specialty markets.• Ability to work independently as well as interdependently in a team\-oriented environment.• Strong clinical acumen, account\-based selling, analytical, and strategic skills to successfully develop accounts.• Demonstrated ability to seek out and qualify leads, profile new accounts, and build durable relationships with relevant healthcare providers and office staff.• Ability to gain consistent access and develop strong, professional relationships for scientific exchange and promotion with healthcare providers in community and academic settings.• Effective verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational abilities.• Must live in the geographic territory or live within 50 miles of the geographic territory border.• Ability to travel within territory on a regular basis, which may include frequent overnight and weekend travel.• Valid driver’s license and clean driving record.• The duties of this role are generally conducted in a field environment. As is typical of a field\-based role, employees must be able, with or without an accommodation, to travel by public transportation, automobile, train, or plane; work comfortably in a clinical setting; use a computer; engage in communications via phone, video, and electronic messaging; problem solve; engage in complex and non\-linear thought, analysis, and dialogue; collaborate with others; and maintain general availability during standard business hours.


**Preferred qualifications:**• Advanced or master’s degree.• 5 years pharmaceutical sales or equivalent experience in specialty, rare disease, nephrology, or related markets.• Sales experience

jobs.title: Cost Account Manager - Cost Plus Contracts
jobs.description:
**Please review the job details below.**
----------------------------------------

  

Lanteris Space is seeking an experienced Cost Account Manager to support our Cost Plus Civil Space programs for our offices in Palo Alto CA. This role may also be performed remotely within the U.S. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing, monitoring, and reporting cost account performance to ensure compliance with contract requirements, internal financial controls, and program objectives. This role requires strong financial acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to work cross\-functionally with engineering, procurement, scheduling and program management teams.


**Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned cost accounts within the Cost Plus program, ensuring accurate tracking of labor, materials, subcontracts, and other direct costs
* Monitor budget\-to\-actual variances and provide timely analysis of cost performance
* Develop and maintain Estimates at Completion (EAC) and Estimates to Complete (ETC)
* Support monthly financial close processes and reconciliation activities
* Identify cost trends, risks, and opportunities for cost savings
* Prepare variance analysis reports and explanations for management review
* Support Integrated Baseline Reviews (IBRs) and other program reviews
* Ensure compliance with FAR/DFARS regulations and contract requirements for Cost Plus programs
* Prepare accurate and timely financial reports for internal and external stakeholders
* Support government audits (DCAA/DCMA) by providing documentation and cost justification
* Maintain proper cost segregation between contract line items and ensure allowability of costs
* Partner with project leads, engineers, and program managers to forecast resource needs
* Collaborate with procurement on subcontract cost management
* Work with accounting to ensure proper cost allocation and recording
* Participate in program meetings to provide financial insights and recommendations

**Minimum Requirements**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field
* 8 years of experience in cost account management, preferably in aerospace/defense
* Experience with Cost\-Plus government contracts (CPFF, CPAF, CPIF) with responsibility for technical, financial, and contractual performance.
* Experience managing program financials, including forecasting, funding management, Estimates at Completion (EACs), staffing, and resource planning.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Finance, Accounting, or MBA
* Professional certification (CPA, CMA, or EVP certification)
* Knowledge of commercial space architectures, missions, systems, requirements, and acquisition methods required and be able to strategize unique solutions.
* Experience with Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) development and maintenance
* Experience with Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS)

  

In support of pay transparency at Lanteris Space Systems, we disclose salary ranges on all U.S. job postings. The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the salary range provided below and is determined based on job\-related factors, including, but not limited to, the experience, qualifications, knowledge, skills, geographic work location, and market conditions. Candidates with the minimum necessary experience, qualifications, knowledge, and skillsets for the position should not expect to receive the upper end of the pay range.


 The base pay for this position within Colorado is: $97,000\.00 \- $161,000\.00 annually. The base pay for this position within New Jersey is: $97,000\.00 \- $161,000\.00 annually. The base pay for this position within Delaware is: $97,000\.00 \- $161,000\.00 annually. The base pay for this position within the Washington, DC metropolitan area is: $107,000\.00 \- $178,000\.00 annually. The base pay for this position within California is: $111,000\.00 \- $185,000\.00 annually.
For all other states, we use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop market\-driven ranges for our roles, and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range.  



  

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, health and welfare insurance, and 401(k) to eligible employees. More information on our benefits will be shared with candidates as they move forward in the recruitment process.


The application window is three days from the date the job is posted and will remain posted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire. If the job is reposted regardless of reason, it will remain posted three days from the date the job is reposted and will remain reposted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire.

  

  

The date of posting can be found on the Lanteris Space Systems Career page at the top of each job posting.

  

  

To apply, submit your application via the Lanteris Space Systems Career page.

  

**Lanteris Space Systems values diversity in the workplace and is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.**

jobs.title: Account Manager - Northern California/Northern Nevada
jobs.description:
**SAVARIA PATIENT CARE**
Built from a heritage of brands including Span America, Handicare and Silvalea, Savaria Patient Care provides products designed for safe patient handling and positive outcomes. Our research and clinically based product portfolio include therapeutic support surfaces for pressure management and positioning, medical beds, a complete range of innovative ceiling and floor lifts and slings. Savaria Patient Care is a division of Savaria Corporation, a global leader in accessibility solutions.  

Job Posting Title **Account Manager \- Northern California/Northern Nevada** **JOB SUMMARY:**
The Account Manager is assigned a geographic region (Northern California/Northern Nevada) to maintain and increase the sales of medical products, meet individual sales objectives, attend assigned trade and product shows, and work with distributor representatives as well as end users. They will be responsible for selling mostly capital equipment through distributors, dealers as well as servicing and selling direct to facilities in the territory, i.e., long\-term care, rehabilitation centers, hospice, homecare, VAMC and state facilities. The base is $70,000 with an anticipated first year on\-target earnings of $160,0000 and second year of $200,000\+.  

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS:*** Develop an annual territory sales plan and provide quarterly updates to the Region Manager.
* Develop, maintain and expand customer base, follow up on leads and maintain key customer relationships. To accomplish this, the following departments are point\-of\-call: Executive Directors, Director of Nursing, Wound Care nurses, case managers, maintenance, biomed, prosthetics, OT/PT/KT, contracting officers and logistics.
* Meet or exceed sales objectives to achieve the established sales plan.
* Responsible for customer support for all product collateral (samples, literature, etc.)
* Provide in\-service education and training to all customers.
* Transport equipment to and from sales calls and trade shows including but not limited to beds, floor lifts, and surfaces.
* Participate in clinical programs and workshops within your territory as assigned.
* Support the Quality Policy, Quality System, and follow established procedures.
* Attend regional and national sales meetings as scheduled.
* Follow safety rules to protect yourself and company equipment.
* Perform other duties as assigned by management.
* Work with all our national, regional, and local distributors.

 **SUPERVISORY** **RESPONSIBILITIES**: N/A  

**COMPETENCIES:*** Should have sold capital equipment sales background.
* Uses resources efficiently and strives to reduce costs as a part of the budgeting process.
* Ability to respond quickly to changing responsibilities and processes.
* Team Oriented
* Effectively communicate with all levels of management
* Solid analytical skills.
* Committed to finding solutions to problems.
* Results\-oriented with a focus on meeting organizational requirements.
* Exhibits sound and accurate judgment.
* Ability to adapt to a wide variety of customer and corporate demands from supporting and diagnosing product function to meeting with c\-suite.
* Supports and upholds the organization’s goals and values.
* Works with integrity.
* Observe safety and security procedures.
* Use a CRM system (SFDC).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook is required.

 **BEHAVIORS:**  

Savaria’s mission is to provide products to improve mobility and access in daily life, so it’s important that all associates embrace this and ensure that they keep our customers at the heart of everything they do, acting in the spirit of our Savaria values all the time:* **Safety** – We are committed to protecting the health and well\-being of customers, the public, and our people.
* **Quality** – We aspire to deliver quality products and services that are right the first time.
* **Customer passion** – What we do makes a difference, and we work with passion to do the best for our customers.
* **Collaboration** – We encourage collaboration to generate ideas and innovation and value clear and open communication to create strong teamwork.
* **Expertise** – Our knowledge and experience have made us industry leaders, and we actively support continuous learning for future growth.

 **LANGUAGE SKILLS:*** Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations. Ability to write reports an business correspondence. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

 **EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE \& TRAINING*** Bachelor’s Degree (B.S.) required.
* 3 \+ years related work experience required.

 **Note:** Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time, with or without notice.

Savaria provides equal employment opportunities and consideration to all qualified employees and applicants, including disabled individuals and veterans.

jobs.title: One Legal Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About the role  

One Legal, an InfoTrack company, is seeking an experienced Customer Success Manager who lives our company values of customer\-centricity, striving for ambitious goals, and respect for colleagues and clients. In this role, you will play a key part in driving revenue growth and increasing client retention to support long\-term loyalty across the One Legal client base.


As a Customer Success Manager, you are responsible for playing a key role in driving revenue growth and increasing client retention to ensure long\-term loyalty of the One Legal client base. It is important that in this role you drive customer\-centricity, striving for ambitious goals centered around increasing revenue. Strong sales acumen with demonstrated experience proactively outbounding into existing accounts to identify growth opportunities, uncover unmet needs, and drive expansion revenue. It is important that as a Customer Success Manager, you are able to build and maintain strong customer relationships. You must be able to thrive in a fast\-paced environment while demonstrating high energy, optimism, and executive presence that inspires clients and drives momentum.  

  

This role is ideal for candidates who enjoy combining customer success with sales\-driven growth, thrive in an energetic, in\-office environment, and are comfortable with proactive outbound engagement


This is a full\-time, base salary plus commission, hybrid position based out of our San Francisco office with regular in\-office presence required 3 days a week. Most work is conducted via phone and video, with in\-office collaboration as part of the hybrid schedule. The role may also require occasional travel to company\-sponsored events and conferences approximately 3–6 times per year.

 **The starting base salary range for this role is $66,960–$83,700\. In addition, this role is eligible for an annual target commission of $45,000, with total compensation determined based on experience, qualifications, and internal pay equity.**


About One Legal, an InfoTrack Company
One Legal, a division of InfoTrack, is a one\-stop online solution for legal professionals to file court documents in every California court, manage service of process nationwide, and more. A leader in innovative technology solutions for legal professionals for more than 30 years, One Legal continues to be among the most respected in the industry.

  

As a highly ambitious company, we know that our people are critical to our success. That's why we're passionate about fostering a high\-performance culture built on professional development, open communication, and transparent leadership. If you're smart, dedicated, and eager to help build a market\-leading solution that makes a difference in the lives of our clients, join us.


Responsibilities* Serve as the lead point of contact for your assigned accounts, providing exceptional customer service and building strong, long\-lasting relationships.
* Conduct informational product demos and training to identify opportunities to expand product usage and increase customer retention.
* Collaborate with the sales team to identify and grow opportunities within the client base, utilizing your sales disposition and high activity level.
* Forecast and track key account metrics, prepare reports on account status, and proactively prevent customer churn.
* Assist with challenging client requests or issue escalations as needed, demonstrating high impact communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Attend tradeshows organized by the marketing team, representing One Legal and showcasing our solutions to potential clients.
* This is a hybrid role based in our San Francisco office, with regular in\-office presence required three days a week

  

**Requirements**  

* 2\-3 years as a B2B Account Executive or similar, selling software to professional services buyers.
* Proven experience in SALES and customer success, account management or relationship sales role, with a track record of achieving sales targets and sustaining client satisfaction.
* Knowledge of the legal and conveyancing process is a plus, with experience in a similar role or within the legal technology industry preferred.
* A consistent record of over\-achievement versus targets and maintaining a healthy sales pipeline.
* Good understanding of the consultative sales approach and appreciation of the value of building trust\-based relationships with your prospects.
* You're a confident communicator and skilled presenter. You enjoy delivering live product demonstrations via video conferencing.
* You're technically adept and experienced with web technologies. Ideally, you've previously worked selling SaaS solutions.

Familiarity with the main tools and tactics of selling. You've used a CRM to track and manage your work (ideally Salesforce).  
* 

  

  

**Benefits**

jobs.title: Executive Operations Associate, Office of the CEO
jobs.description:
**About Distyl AI**
===================

Distyl is an applied AI technology company partnering with the world’s most ambitious institutions to rearchitect critical operations for the frontier of AI. Our customers include the largest companies in telecom, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, consumer goods, and global social organizations.  

  

We research and deploy technologies that power AI\-native operations — both for our partners and for Distyl itself. Our work spans research into self\-constructing systems, the development of the most reliable execution of AI systems, and products that transform mission\-critical workflows. As a result, Distyl's technologies affect some of the world's largest operations — from hundreds of millions of consumer interactions to tens of millions of supply chain transactions and millions of patient journeys.  

  

Distyl is backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Coatue, DST Global, and the board\-members of 20\+ F500s.


**Why This Role Exists**
------------------------


Distyl’s CEO operates at a fast pace across Fortune 500 customers, investors, board members, candidates, partners, and the press, often across multiple cities in the same week. Keeping that work moving requires someone who can manage critical details while also solving unfamiliar problems with speed and judgment.


This role is equal parts executive support and business problem\-solving. You will coordinate complex logistics, manage priorities, build relationships, and take ambiguous requests from idea to completion. You will not simply manage activity around the CEO; you will help the entire operation run better.


This is an opportunity for an ambitious professional to learn how a high\-growth AI company is built from inside the Office of the CEO. You will receive significant exposure and you will earn increasing responsibility by executing exceptionally well, demonstrating sound judgment, and consistently taking work off the CEO’s plate.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Turn requests into outcomes.** Take ownership of unfamiliar, multi\-step needs—whether securing an urgent international visa, preparing for an important meeting, researching a business question, or coordinating a strategic project. Determine the path forward, involve the right people, and drive the work to completion.

**Create leverage for the CEO.** Manage scheduling, travel, meeting preparation, personal logistics, and follow\-up with precision. Maintain a clear view of priorities and commitments so important details do not get dropped.

**Deliver exceptional external experiences.** Ensure that candidates, customers, investors, board members, and partners experience thoughtful communication and flawless coordination. When plans change, respond calmly and protect both the relationship and the CEO’s time.

**Help develop important relationships.** Research stakeholders, identify paths to valuable introductions, coordinate thoughtful outreach, and follow up persistently. Learn when to keep pursuing an objective, when to try a different approach, and when to recommend moving on.

**Strengthen the Office of the CEO.** Create trackers, workflows, briefing materials, daily priority summaries, meeting\-preparation standards, and follow\-up systems. Identify recurring friction and build a better process.

**Work across the company.** Coordinate with founders’ associates, executives, employees, and external vendors. Communicate clearly, establish ownership, and keep projects moving even when no one reports directly to you.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* A recent graduate or professional with approximately 0–3 years of experience.
* A strong record of academic, professional, entrepreneurial, or extracurricular achievement.
* High agency and resourcefulness, you try multiple paths to solve a problem rather than dropping the task when the first approach fails.
* Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and follow\-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* The judgment to handle confidential information and interact professionally with senior executives.
* Comfort moving between strategic projects and hands\-on logistics without viewing either as beneath you.
* Intellectual curiosity and the ability to learn unfamiliar subjects quickly.
* A low\-ego, service\-oriented approach combined with ambition and a desire to grow.
* Comfort operating in an environment where priorities move quickly and the playbook is still being written.
* Fluency with AI tools and an instinct for using technology to improve your work.
* Ability to work from our San Francisco office.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* The CEO spends more time on the company’s highest\-value priorities.
* Important commitments and follow\-ups are completed without reminders.
* Complex logistics run smoothly, even when plans change.
* Stakeholders experience Distyl as thoughtful, responsive, and exceptionally well organized.
* Ambiguous requests become completed outcomes.
* The systems supporting the Office of the CEO become increasingly proactive and scalable.
* As trust develops, you take ownership of progressively broader projects and responsibilities.

**Why This Opportunity Is Different**
-------------------------------------


This is not a conventional Executive Assistant position, nor is it a purely strategic role. It is a hands\-on opportunity for someone who wants direct exposure to the decisions, relationships, and operating challenges behind a rapidly growing AI company.


The right person will be equally willing to solve an urgent travel problem, prepare the CEO for a consequential meeting, improve an internal system, or drive a cross\-functional project. No task is too small when it creates leverage, and no problem is too ambiguous to begin solving.

**What We Offer**
=================

* The base salary range for this role is $100K\

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
TIMEPROOFUSA was founded by some of the home remodeling industry's most respected leaders. We have quickly become America's fastest\-growing home improvement company—providing roofing solutions to homeowners across the country. Our rapid growth is driven by one mission: to deliver uncompromising quality, dependable service, and lasting peace of mind to every customer we serve.



As an Outside Sales Representative, you'll run pre\-set, qualified appointments, educate homeowners on our roofing solutions, and close projects in\-home.


**$4,000 SIGN\-ON BONUS**


**What You'll Do**


* Run pre\-set, qualified appointments with homeowners—no cold calling or lead generation required.
* Conduct professional roofing consultations, product demos, provide same\-day estimates, and close the sale.
* Partner with your Sales Manager and team for ongoing coaching, joint appointments, weekly meetings, and skill development.


**What's In It for You**


* 100% commission W\-2 role with uncapped earnings \+ monthly bonuses.
* On target earnings between $150K–$320K\+ annually.
* Pre\-set qualified leads—focus on closing, not prospecting.
* 4 weeks paid training at $1,000/week, plus earn full commission — not a draw.
* Full benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401(k).
* $4,000 Sign\-On Bonus.
* Monthly car allowance
* Cell phone allowance \& company provided iPad


**What It Takes To Succeed**


* Resilience and ability to handle rejection without being discouraged.
* Ability to drive 100 miles a day on average.
* Availability to work evenings and weekends.
* Comfortable working in a commission\-based role.
* Strong ability to navigate complex conversations and close deals on the spot.
* Technological proficiency in using an iPad.
* Submit to a background screening.
* Valid driver's license and vehicle insurance.


**More About TIMEPROOFUSA**



TIMEPROOFUSA is redefining the future of roofing. With fire\-safe materials, sustainable technology, and a leadership team backed by decades of success in home remodeling, we're building smarter, safer homes that stand the test of time.



Our core values—People First, Innovation, Customer Obsession, Integrity \& Craftsmanship, and Profit Fuels Our Future—aren't just words on a wall. They drive how we build, lead, and win together.



If you're the kind of person who thrives on challenge, takes pride in excellence, and wants to be part of a team that's changing the industry, this is your moment.



Apply today, take the next step in your career, and let's build something extraordinary together.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, Outbound (Hybrid - SF)
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

  

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR \& IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.

  

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third\-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

This is a high\-activity, outbound Sales Development role. You’ll be responsible for creating a sales pipeline by researching target accounts, reaching prospects through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels, and booking qualified meetings for Account Executives.

  

It is a focused top\-of\-funnel role for someone who is energized by prospecting, fast feedback loops, daily activity goals, and a team environment where performance is visible and celebrated. This is not an inbound or full\-cycle sales role.

  

You’ll learn Rippling’s full platform, understand the operational pain points our customers face, and build the foundation for a long\-term career in sales. Successful SDRs typically spend time in\-seat developing core prospecting, discovery, objection\-handling, and territory\-management skills before furthering their sales career.

 ***(This is a hybrid role and you will be required to be in the office 3x per week in San Francisco, CA)***

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Research target companies, personas, business triggers, and operational pain points to identify high\-quality prospecting opportunities
* Prospect into target accounts using phone, email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement tools
* Own a high\-volume outbound motion, including daily call blocks, email follow\-ups, account research, and multi\-touch sequences
* Work toward clear daily and weekly activity expectations, including roughly 80–100 calls and 40–50 emails per day, depending on territory priorities and team guidance
* Qualify prospects using defined criteria and schedule high\-quality meetings for Account Executives
* Partner closely with Account Executives on territory strategy, account prioritization, messaging, and follow\-ups
* Participate actively in weekly enablement sessions, team call reviews, and manager coaching; apply feedback quickly to improve your messaging, objection handling, and overall prospecting effectiveness
* Maintain accurate records in Salesforce and keep outreach, account, and prospect data clean
* Leverage tools like Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo, and dialer technology to execute efficiently

**Qualifications**
------------------

* BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience
* A high sense of urgency and genuine interest in a sales career
* Strong communication skills, especially over the phone and in concise, written outreach
* Coachability \- you can take feedback, apply it quickly, and improve from one call to the next
* Curiosity and initiative \- you ask good questions, seek context, and look for ways to get better without waiting to be told
* Resilience and consistency in a high\-activity prospecting environment
* Comfort working toward measurable goals in a competitive, team\-oriented setting
* Ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with sales, marketing, and other teams
* Prior sales, customer\-facing, athletics, or competitive team experience is helpful, but not required

 **What success looks like**
In your first 30 days, you’ll focus on onboarding, product knowledge, sales methodology, tools, messaging, and understanding Rippling’s customers.  

By month two, you’ll begin ramping into live prospecting, building activity consistency, and working toward partial quota expectations.  

By month three, you should be operating at full ramp expectations, managing daily outbound activity, booking qualified meetings, and showing consistent improvement through coaching and repetition.  

Longer term, success in this role means building the skills and track record to grow your sales career at Rippling \- whether that path is toward Account Executive, SDR leadership, or another go\-to\-market role. **Why join Rippling*** You’ll sell a product that solves real operational problems for companies \- not a narrow point solution
* You’ll learn how businesses run across HR, IT, Finance, payroll, benefits, devices, apps, and more
* You’ll join a fast\-paced, high\-performance sales environment with strong coaching, clear goals, and room to grow
* You’ll be part of a collaborative SDR team that values healthy competition, accountability, and continuous improvement

You’ll get exposure to a rapidly expanding platform, including newer product areas such as AI and data  
* 

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@r

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Adapt**


Every company will have a central company agent. Adapt is the platform for building, running, and governing it. We connect the models a company chooses to its systems, data, people, and workflows. With persistent memory, secure compute, deep integrations, reusable skills, and enterprise controls, Adapt helps the agent understand real context, complete real work, and improve over time.  

We believe this infrastructure should be open, portable, secure, and controlled by the organizations that depend on it. Models will change. What a company builds with Adapt stays theirs. Join us in building the platform that will define how companies work with AI. **About the role**


We are hiring an early Business Development Representative to create high\-quality sales opportunities with companies that can become great Adapt customers. You will combine account research, product and market signals, thoughtful outreach, and technical curiosity to open the right conversations.


You will find companies with a real reason to care about Adapt and earn the first serious conversation. That means researching accounts, reading product and market signals, writing outreach that shows judgment, and learning enough to identify a credible problem, champion, and next step. Your work is judged by whether your Account Executive accepts the opportunity and it advances, not by email volume or meetings booked. You own the journey from target\-account research through a well\-qualified handoff; the Account Executive owns deeper discovery and the opportunity after acceptance.


You will use AI deeply for research, signal detection, personalization, and experimentation without treating automation as a substitute for judgment or empathy.

 **What you will own**

* Account research and prioritization. Understand a company's business, team, systems, AI posture, likely workflows, relevant events, and buying committee before reaching out.
* Signal\-led outreach. Use product activity, website intent, hiring, funding, relationships, and market events to prioritize relevant outreach across email, LinkedIn, communities, and events.
* Early qualification. Establish the trigger, problem, likely use case, account fit, initial champion, and next step before requesting sales acceptance.
* Handoff quality. Give the Account Executive clear context on why the account engaged, what matters, who is involved, and what has already been learned.
* Experimentation and feedback. Test research methods, AI\-assisted workflows, messages, channels, and account plays while returning objections and market patterns to Sales, Marketing, and Product.

 **What success looks like**

* You meet the agreed ramp target for sales\-accepted opportunities and sourced qualified pipeline.
* Your handoffs convert because they contain useful account, stakeholder, problem, and timing context.
* You build repeatable, AI\-assisted research and outbound workflows that improve relevance, learning speed, and accepted opportunities, and you can explain what signals, audiences, and messages are working.

 **What we are looking for**

* 1\+ years in business development, sales development, recruiting, customer\-facing work, or another high\-accountability professional role
* Strong concise writing and evidence that you can earn attention through thoughtful, personalized outreach
* Curiosity about AI, developer tools, APIs, infrastructure, and how companies operate
* An AI\-native operating mindset: you are excited to test new tools, redesign your workflows, and continually improve how high\-quality opportunities are created
* Organization, follow\-through, resilience, and high standards for CRM data
* Experience selling or recruiting technical audiences
* Experience building research, enrichment, or outbound automations

 **Benefits**

* Competitive compensation strategy including large equity grants for early hires at an early stage in the company's journey
* Inclusive healthcare packages (medical, dental, vision)
* Frontier AI access: Claude Code, OpenAI, Cursor, Codex, and most importantly unlimited internal use of Adapt itself

  

OTE: $100\-130k. Actual offer depends on skills, experience, and location. Total comp also includes equity, benefits, and potential bonus or variable pay. Your recruiter will walk you through the details.

  

Adapt is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Adapt encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

jobs.title: Whirlpool Territory Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Mosaic is the leading North American Integrated Agency, specializing in Experiential Marketing, Sales and Merchandising. At Mosaic, we are never satisfied with the status quo and are in constant search for new ideas and new ways to help our clients build their brands, amidst the evolving dynamic of empowered consumers leveraging new technologies.


Mosaic is currently seeking a highly driven Territory Sales Representative (Full Time) primarily responsible for managing retail stores in a dedicated geographical territory. The TSR will cultivate relationships with retail partners and field leadership and collaborate to drive strategic initiatives for increased sales and market share of brand products.


The qualified individual must possess a strong passion for success, an abundance of energy, committed to delivering superior service and performance, a team player excited to learn and grow as a member of the Mosaic team. Additionally, the candidate must be able to comfortably explain appliance benefits and technology, be able to educate consumers and sales associates, make product recommendations, and build strong relationships in the stores to ultimately drive an increase in sales of Whirlpool products.


Salary $70,000 Plus Bonus Potential

* Responsible for a geographic territory and supporting national accounts and key independent trade customers both in person as well as virtually to build relationships and ensure sales targets are achieved, all while identifying and analyzing performance trends.
* Build and maintain essential relationships with trade customers through conducting group meetings, incentives, lunch \& learns, and other strategic activities to help drive sales.
* While not directly responsible for maintaining the physical presence of products on display and managing plan\-o\-gram product placement, building relationships with Mosaic and Display Execution teams and store merchandise and management teams is critical to the overall success of the program.
* Deliver presentations where needed to educate retail, direct and business teams on clients' key product differentiators, messages, promotions, etc.
* Gather competitive intelligence and report on specific competitive tactics including price moves, new products and merchandising materials;
* Maintain working knowledge of all products to be a subject matter expert and direct questions from retail associates related to product issues, allocation and inventory challenges to clients' field sales team.
* As requested, attend and execute at marketing events, customer rallies, product launch activities to educate and train on clients' products key features and service offerings.
* Miscellaneous duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - San Francisco
jobs.description:
Sales · Full\-time · San Francisco

  

Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

### **About the role**


As a Sales Development Representative at Cursor, you'll be the tip of the spear for pipeline generation, the first voice a prospective customer hears, and the person who earns their attention before an Account Executive ever gets on a call. You'll work across the full range of our commercial segments, from fast\-moving startups to mid\-market engineering organizations, identifying the right buyers and creating the conditions for meaningful sales conversations.


This isn't a role for someone who waits for leads to come in. You'll build pipeline from scratch, learn how great engineering teams think, and develop a deep understanding of how Cursor transforms developer productivity. It's the fastest way to learn enterprise sales at one of the most exciting companies in AI.

 **What you'll do**

* Generate qualified pipeline for our Account Executive team through high\-volume outbound prospecting, including cold calls, personalized emails, LinkedIn, and creative multi\-channel sequences
* Research target accounts and map stakeholders across Engineering, Product, and Leadership to identify the right entry points
* Conduct discovery conversations that go beyond surface\-level qualification, understand how development teams work, what's slowing them down, and where Cursor fits
* Partner closely with AEs to develop account strategies, hand off opportunities cleanly, and stay looped in as deals progress
* Hit and exceed weekly activity targets and monthly qualified meeting goals
* Represent Cursor's brand and product with conviction; you'll be many prospects' first impression of the company
* Bring market intelligence back to the team: what resonates, what objections are coming up, what messaging is landing
* Help build the playbook. As an early SDR, your patterns and learnings will shape how this function scales

 **You may be a fit if**

* You have 1–2 years of experience in a sales, customer\-facing, or business development role. SDR/BDR experience at a SaaS or developer tools company is a strong plus
* You're a relentless self\-starter who takes ownership of your pipeline and doesn't wait to be handed leads
* You write and speak with clarity. You can explain a complex product simply and tailor your message to a technical audience
* You're curious about how software gets built and excited by the idea that AI is fundamentally changing the craft
* You're organized and data\-driven: you track your activity, learn from your numbers, and iterate quickly
* You have thick skin and genuine resilience. You don't take rejection personally and you bounce back fast
* You want to grow into an Account Executive role and are willing to put in the reps to get there

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

**About the role**

  

ElevenLabs moves fast \- and behind every high\-performing leader is someone who makes sure nothing slips. This is a high\-trust, hands\-on role for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, holds themselves to a high standard, and takes genuine pride in making their lead's life easier \- down to the small, considered details that others overlook.

  

You'll be the operational backbone for senior leadership \- managing calendars, coordinating across time zones, handling logistics, and owning the day\-to\-day administrative tasks that let leadership focus on what matters most.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own calendars and time allocation for finance leadership team, making trade\-off calls independently against stated priorities
* Prepare executives for every meeting: pre\-reads, context, and the decision needed \- including board and investor sessions
* Capture actions out of meetings and chase them to completion
* Triage executive inboxes and draft correspondence
* Automate the mechanical parts of the role \- briefing prep, triage, scheduling, recurring reporting
* Run discrete projects: board logistics, executive travel, offsites, and the finance team's operating cadence

**Requirements**

* Experience supporting multiple senior executives in a high\-velocity environment
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities, shifting timelines, and multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, from senior executives and partners to vendors and office guests
* Proven judgment and problem\-solving skills
* Fluency with AI tools and a track record of automating your own work \- come ready to show what you've built
* High emotional intelligence and discretion \- trusted with sensitive information
* Fluency in English

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

ASAP Engagement Coordinator (Academic ASAP Program Coordinator)


**POSITION DETAILS**


Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens **,** LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). LaGuardia offers more than sixty associate degree programs and more than fifty workforce training, ESOL, GED, and pre\-college programs. In 2023, LaGuardia served approximately 24,000 students. More than one\-third of LaGuardia’s degree\-seeking students are born outside the United States; they come from 136 countries and speak 43 heritage languages. Sixty percent are first\-generation college students.


Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25\. Forty\-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. Upon graduation most students transfer to four\-year colleges, typically in CUNY, to complete their baccalaureate degrees. Graduates of career programs such as Nursing, Computer Technology, and Veterinary Technology enter the workforce. LaGuardia ranked fifth among U.S. community colleges in economic mobility – moving low\-income students into the middle class and beyond – in studies by Stanford University (2017\) and the Brookings Institution (2020\).Please visit www.laguardia.edu to learn more.


Accelerated Study in Associate Programs (ASAP) helps motivated community college students earn degrees as quickly as possible, with a goal of graduating at least 50% of students within three years. Key ASAP program features include a consolidated block schedule, cohorts by major, required full\-time study, mandatory tutoring, and comprehensive advisement and career development services. Financial incentives include tuition waivers for financial aid\-eligible students and free use of textbooks and monthly Transportation support for all students. Further information is available at www.cuny.edu/ASAP About ASAP Labor \& Employment Law

* Monitors and maintains student enrollment and information databases; collects and maintains statistical data, and prepares reports and surveys using student information and enrollment data;

* Collaborates with Academic Program Specialist, Engagement Specialist, and Career Specialist to support special initiatives (e.g. STEM; Foster Care Initiative; Research Scholars);
* Provides mentoring and guidance to support to a small cohort of students as needed and has flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends.


**QUALIFICATIONS**

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


* Experience in higher education or working with college students strongly preferred
* Strong understanding of the educational needs and challenges facing students from diverse urban backgrounds
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team as well as independently with minimal supervision
* Experience developing, organizing and delivering presentations to students and staff

* Experience providing coaching and mentoring
* Experience with MS office (word, excel)
* Demonstrated knowledge of equitable and inclusive practices to support and engage students

jobs.title: Program Coordinator (part-time)
jobs.description:
At InterExchange, we are on a mission to promote meaningful intercultural connections through experiential international exchange programs. Our Career Training USA program promotes professional development and cross\-cultural collaboration by helping a diverse group of participants intern or train with U.S. businesses. If you are enthusiastic about supporting work\-based learning and are a flexible and diplomatic team player who is ready to learn all aspects of this unique exchange program, we want you to join us!
As our new Program Coordinator, you will be the initial point of contact for prospective interns and trainees and their U.S. host employers, educating them about the program and visa sponsorship process. You will coach participants and hosts throughout the application process and take ownership over application decisions. While participants are in\-country, you will offer assistance and direct them and their hosts to resources to ensure they have a successful experience. Finally, you will also collaborate with colleagues on the team and across the organization to ensure our participants are happy and safe and that our program doesn’t just adhere to regulations but also provides life\-changing cultural exchange experiences.


**What you'll do:*** Provide excellent customer service to prospective applicants and host organizations who inquire about the program and use your expertise to provide timely and helpful information
* Advise and assist applicants and hosts throughout the visa sponsorship application process, while encouraging best practices to ensure success and satisfaction
* Review applications and screen and interview participants and hosts to assess their eligibility for the Career Training USA program, per Department of State regulations
* Guide participants and hosts throughout the in\-country program, answering questions and highlighting resources for having an exceptional experience in the U.S.




**Who you are:*** An enthusiastic self\-starter who enjoys working with people of diverse nationalities and cultures
* A detail\-oriented individual who has proven strategies for time\-management and prioritization
* A problem\-solver who can approach issues with compassion and cultural sensitivity
* A decision\-maker who is comfortable guiding others through ambiguous or evolving situations




**Your Qualifications Include:*** Demonstrated experience in administrative and/or customer service roles, either through work or internships
* Strong motivation to proactively identify opportunities and address potential challenges
* Ability to express ideas clearly and concisely in verbal and written form, adapting to different internal/external audiences
* Strong attention to detail, with accuracy and consistency of work, balanced with effective time management
* Proficiency in productivity applications, i.e., Microsoft/Google Suites, with a willingness to learn our proprietary software and internal communications tools




**Compensation:**
$30 \- 35 / hour,based on your level of experience


**Schedule \& Hours:**This is a part\-time role, at 20–21 hours per week, with flexibility in how your hours are structured. The preferred schedule options are:* 4 hours / day, 5 days / week (Mon \& Fri onsite, Tue \- Thu remote)
* 7 hours / day, 3 days / week (fully onsite)


Hours are scheduled Monday through Friday, between 9:30 AM and 5:30 PM, with flexible start and end times available within that window.


**Location:**
You’ll be based in our downtown Manhattan office at least Tuesday through Thursday, and additional days may be worked remotely as needed


**Start Date:**Preferably as soon as October 1, 2026, depending on your availability.


**Travel:** None
### **How to Apply**

### **Complete our online application and upload your resume**




**Benefits \& Perks of Employment at InterExchange*** Affordable, quality medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401k retirement plan with safe harbor employer contribution
* Generous paid time off and health time off package
* Employer\-sponsored life insurance
* Flex\-time options
* Professional Development \& Educational Assistance Program
* Pre\-tax FSA for medical and/or dependent care expenses
* Pre\-tax commuter benefits
* Supplemental insurance plans
* Pet Insurance Discount




### **About Us**


InterExchange is a private, nonprofit organization with over 50 years of experience in international cultural exchange. We are dedicated to promoting international understanding through development and implementation of affordable intercultural and life experiential work/training opportunities. By participating in InterExchange programs both in the U.S. and abroad, tens of thousands of young people and their hosts have gained insight into other cultures. InterExchange is designated by the U.S. Department of State to sponsor several J\-1 Visa exchange programs including Au Pair USA, Work \& Travel USA, Camp USA, and Career Training USA. Program participants are placed in the U.S. and abroad by InterExchange in collaboration with international cooperating agencies and government agencies. Additionally, we offer Work Abroad opportunities for Americans seeking similar experience overseas.


**Opportunities for All**
InterExchange is fully committed to providing opportunities for people across all dimensions of race, ethnicity, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, age, sensory, mental, or physical abilities, religious beliefs, marital status, veteran status, political beliefs, and more. We strive to maintain an environment for our staff, leadership, and board that is vibrant, welcoming, innovative, collaborative, and free of barriers and discriminatory practices—strengthening our programs while reinforcing our commitment to the field of cultural exchange.
Any essential function or requirement of this job will be evaluated as necessary should an applicant be unable to perform the function or requireme

jobs.description:
The Development Operations Coordinator provides essential administrative and operational support to iMentor’s Development team. Reporting to the Vice President of Philanthropy \& Development Operations, this role is responsible for maintaining accurate fundraising data, processing philanthropic gifts, supporting donor acknowledgments and reporting, and ensuring that Development staff have the timely and reliable information they need to effectively manage donor relationships and fundraising activity.



The Coordinator will work extensively within Salesforce and other fundraising platforms to maintain strong data integrity and execute the day\-to\-day processes that keep the Development department running smoothly. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys detailed database work, takes pride in accuracy and organization, and finds satisfaction in providing excellent service and operational support to colleagues and donors.



The Coordinator will work extensively within Salesforce and other fundraising platforms, and will also serve as a close partner to external relations leaders in building strong team culture and coordinating department\-level meetings and communications.


### **Gift Processing and Administration**


* Process philanthropic gifts and pledges accurately and promptly, including gifts received by check, EFT, stock, donor\-advised fund, matching gift, and through other giving vehicles.
* Maintain complete and accurate gift, pledge, payment, and donor information in Salesforce.
* Prepare and process timely donor acknowledgment letters, receipts, and other gift\-related correspondence.
* Maintain accurate pledge schedules and payment information and support relationship managers with upcoming pledge payment reminders and follow\-up.
* Ensure corporate matching and volunteer donations and other specialized gift types are recorded accurately and include the appropriate donor and organizational information.
* Produce regular gift reports and documentation, work closely with Finance to research and resolve gift discrepancies, and support accurate reconciliation of philanthropic revenue.
* Identify and support opportunities to improve gift processing, acknowledgment, and reconciliation workflows.
* Process Development team invoices, expense documentation, and American Express reports.
### **CRM and Data Integrity**


* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date donor, prospect, organization, gift, opportunity, contact, and engagement information in Salesforce.
* Conduct routine data\-quality reviews and cleanup to identify missing, duplicate, outdated, or inconsistent constituent information.
* Ensure relationship managers have current contact information, giving history, engagement records, and other relevant data needed to effectively manage donor relationships.
* Help troubleshoot routine Salesforce questions for Development team members.
* Partner with appropriate internal staff when technical Salesforce changes or more complex database support are required.
### **Reporting and Development Team Support**


* Generate recurring and ad hoc fundraising reports, lists, data exports, and invitation, solicitation, mailing, stewardship, donor, and prospect lists based on team needs.
* Monitor shared Development communications, including the department’s general email inbox, and ensure inquiries are routed and addressed appropriately.
* Provide administrative support for department\-wide projects and activities in a timely and service\-oriented manner as needed.
* Conduct preliminary donor and prospect research and prepare profiles on an ad hoc basis to support relationship managers and organizational leadership.
### **Events \& Campaign Administration**


* Create and maintain fundraising and event pages within GoFundMe Pro, including the administrative infrastructure necessary to launch campaigns.
* Maintain accurate campaign, participant, registration, donor, attendance, and engagement information across fundraising platforms and Salesforce.
* Produce event and campaign progress reports and support post\-event or post\-campaign data reconciliation and reporting.
* Support the Development team with other administrative event and campaign needs as assigned.
### **Qualifications**


* 1–4 years of experience in nonprofit administration, development operations, fundraising administration, database management, customer service, or a related role.
* Experience working regularly in a CRM or database environment; Salesforce experience strongly preferred.
* Experience with nonprofit gift processing, donor databases, fundraising operations, or financial reconciliation preferred.
* Strong attention to detail, excellent organizational skills, and a demonstrated commitment to data accuracy.
* Strong customer\-service orientation and genuine enjoyment of supporting colleagues and responding to requests thoughtfully and efficiently.
* Ability to work carefully with confidential donor and financial information and exercise sound judgment and discretion.
* Comfort working with Microsoft Excel and other common office and productivity tools and ability to learn and work within fundraising and technology platforms such as Salesforce and GoFundMe Pro.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, reliability, follow\-through, and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.

**Job Description**

Transportation Planning and Management (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  

  

The Office of Livable Streets (OLS) is tasked with prioritizing strategic planning, community engagement, research, policy, design, implementation, and long\-term management. Their goal is to create streets that are livable, supporting safety, accessibility, inclusion, resiliency, active modes, community cohesion, and economic vitality citywide. Additionally, they aim to enhance New York City's pedestrian, bicycle, and micromobility networks, providing comfortable, connected, green, and reliable transportation options across the five boroughs. They place special emphasis on Priority Investment Areas, mode shift, and reimagining streets. The office also develops innovative new programs, design typologies, project delivery, and analysis tools to meet the demands of a rapidly changing population with evolving needs and technologies.
  

  

The Cycling \& Micromobility Unit is responsible for the nation's largest network of on\-street bicycle facilities (1,200\+ lane\-miles), enhancing street safety for all users, and increasing bike ridership in the five boroughs. The team's focus is the innovative redesign of city streets to expand and improve the bike network, with emphasis on improving connectivity between neighborhoods, increasing access to safe bicycle infrastructure across the city, and creating a more equitable transportation network that serves all New Yorkers.
  

The Cycling \& Micromobility unit seeks to hire an Operations Coordinator to support the launch and implementation of the Secure Bike Program (SBP). Over the next five years, NYC DOT will install 500 secure bike parking facilities, creating thousands of safe, convenient bicycle parking spaces across New York City. This initiative will make cycling more accessible and practical by supporting ownership of a wide range of bicycles, including cargo bikes, adaptive bikes, and UL\-certified e\-bikes.
  

Under the supervision of the Senior Program Manager, the Operations Coordinator will play a key role in the deployment and operation of SBP facilities citywide. The candidate will evaluate existing site conditions and document findings to identify technically feasible locations for SBP installations, review installation plans and site layouts to ensure accuracy and compliance with project requirements, coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to address site\-specific issues and support successful facility deployment, and provide general support for project planning and implementation. The candidate will perform post\-installation inspections to verify facilities are installed according to approved plans and specifications, conduct routine field inspections to monitor facility conditions and ensure compliance with maintenance and service requirements, document inspection findings, and coordinate corrective actions as needed. The candidate will maintain accurate records of site assessments, installations, inspections, and operational activities using program databases and tracking systems, assist with performance monitoring and reporting related to facility operations and contractor service compliance, and support pre\-installation notifications and other administrative activities associated with project delivery. The candidate will support community engagement activities related to the Secure Bike Program, prepare work orders based upon field conditions, assist with inquiries and support communication efforts related to SBP, and perform additional duties and special projects related to the implementation and operation of the program, as assigned.
  

We are looking for a detail\-oriented, proactive, and collaborative professional with strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills. The candidate should be comfortable working both independently and as part of a team and demonstrate a willingness to conduct fieldwork year\-round while traveling by bicycle, on foot, or via public transit.
  

The Department of Transportation’s (DOT) mission is to provide for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods in the City of New York and to maintain and enhance the transportation infrastructure crucial to the economic vitality and quality of life of our primary customers, City residents. DOT is an equal opportunity employer, committed to recruiting and maintaining a diverse workforce in an open and inclusive environment.

Administrative Coordinator \- International Student Services


**POSITION DETAILS**


Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens, LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). LaGuardia offers more than sixty associate degree programs and more than fifty workforce training, ESOL, GED, and pre\-college programs. In 2023, LaGuardia served approximately 24,000 students. More than one\-third of LaGuardia’s degree\-seeking students are born outside the United States; they come from 136 countries and speak 43 heritage languages. Sixty percent are first\-generation college students.


Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25\. Forty\-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. Upon graduation most students transfer to four\-year colleges, typically in CUNY, to complete their baccalaureate degrees. Graduates of career programs such as Nursing, Computer Technology, and Veterinary Technology enter the workforce. LaGuardia ranked fifth among U.S. community colleges in economic mobility – moving low\-income students into the middle class and beyond – in studies by Stanford University (2017\) and the Brookings Institution (2020\). Please visit www.laguardia.edu to learn more.

Bachelor's Degree required.


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Experience supporting administrative or office operations, preferably in a higher education or student services environment.

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced office environment.

Emerald’s talented and experienced teams grow our customers’ businesses 365 days a year with products that create connections, deliver content, and drive commerce. The Event Operations Manager collaborates extensively with internal teams and external partners to manage spending, contracts, onsite design, logistics, and show collateral. **Conference Programs \& Special Events**

**Onsite Execution \& Show Operations**

* Lead onsite operations across move\-in, show staging, and move\-out, ensuring timelines, safety standards, and service requirements are met

* 3\+ years of experience in event operations
