jobs.title: LearnVantage Software Sales Account Exec Manager Enterprise Account Management
jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Accenture LearnVantage is Accenture's comprehensive technology learning and training service, built on a $1 billion investment to help the world's leading organizations reskill and upskill their workforces for the AI economy. Launched in March 2024, LearnVantage brings together three industry\-leading training organizations — Udacity (AI, data science, and digital skills), Award Solutions (advanced wireless, 5G, and network technologies), and Ascendient Learning (instructor\-led IT training and vendor\-authorized certifications) — into a single, AI\-powered platform that delivers personalized, outcomes\-driven workforce transformation at enterprise scale.


We sit at the intersection of Accenture's deepest client relationships and the most urgent workforce challenge in the market: helping global enterprises close the AI skills gap at speed and at scale. With Accenture's trust, reach, and account access as our foundation, LearnVantage is positioned to become the defining workforce reinvention partner for the world's most important organizations.

**You Are:**


A strategic, relationship\-driven enterprise seller who knows how to navigate large, complex organizations — both externally with clients and internally within Accenture. You are equally comfortable sitting in an account planning session with a Managing Director as you are presenting a workforce reinvention business case to a client's CHRO. You understand how Accenture operates, how Diamond Account teams think, and how to position LearnVantage as a natural, high\-value extension of the work Accenture is already doing.


You are not a lone wolf. You are a collaborator, an orchestrator, and a trusted partner to the Accenture account teams you work alongside. You know that in this environment, internal influence is as important as external selling — and you have the credibility, patience, and commercial instincts to build both.

**The Work:**

* Embed within Accenture's Diamond Account and strategic account teams as the dedicated LearnVantage sales resource, attending account planning sessions, QBRs, and client meetings to identify and qualify workforce reinvention opportunities within active Accenture engagements
* Build trusted, recurring relationships with Client Account Leads (CALs), Managing Directors, and Accenture industry leads across assigned accounts, establishing yourself as the go\-to LearnVantage expert within the Accenture ecosystem
* Identify the right moment to introduce LearnVantage into active Accenture transformation programs — attaching AI, data, cloud, networking, and certification training to technology implementations, managed services agreements, and change management programs already underway
* Lead executive\-level discovery and solution presentations with client C\-suite stakeholders (CIO, CHRO, CDO, CEO, CLO), positioned as a strategic LearnVantage partner rather than a training vendor add\-on
* Design comprehensive LearnVantage workforce solutions — drawing on LearnVantage AI programs, Award Solutions 5G and network training, and Ascendient Learning IT certification — that complement and accelerate the technology transformations Accenture is delivering
* Present value\-selling business cases that connect LearnVantage investments to measurable client outcomes: AI capability development, technology adoption speed, workforce productivity, talent retention, and long\-term competitive readiness
* Navigate Accenture's internal commercial processes — including CCI considerations, Accenture Funding mechanisms, and co\-investment structures — with the knowledge and credibility to advocate for LearnVantage's commercial interests while maintaining strong internal relationships
* Manage LearnVantage pipeline across all assigned Accenture accounts with disciplined CRM hygiene, accurate forecasting, and regular visibility for both LearnVantage and Accenture leadership
* Convert Accenture\-introduced opportunities into closed, contracted LearnVantage engagements and expand those engagements over time into multi\-year, multi\-solution workforce partnerships
* Serve as the voice of the client and the CAL back to LearnVantage's product, curriculum, and go\-to\-market teams — surfacing emerging skill gaps, deal structure needs, and market opportunities that improve LearnVantage's relevance within the Accenture ecosystem


Travel to client sites and Accenture offices as required to support strategic account pursuits; travel estimated at 30–50% depending on assigned accounts


  

**Here's What You Need:**

* Minimum of 7 years of experience in business development, account management, sales leadership, or new logo acquisition in a consulting, technology, or professional services environment.
* Demonstrated track record of originating and closing significant net new business in mid\-market or multi\-subsidiary environments, preferably $500K\+ ARR deals or more
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

**Bonus Points If:**

* You have direct experience with Accenture's account structure, including familiarity with Diamond Accounts, CAL/MD relationships, and Accenture's internal commercial processes (CCI, Accenture Funding, co\-investment)
* You have experience selling corporate learning, AI and digital skills platforms, managed learning services, IT certification training, or workforce technology into large enterprise accounts
* You have familiarity with any LearnVantage solution area — AI/ML (Udacity), advanced wireless and 5G (Award Solutions), or instructor\-led IT certification (Ascendient Learning)
* You have experience building and scaling a co\-sell motion within a large partner or alliance ecosystem
* You have experience leading or mentoring sales talent and an interest in helping build the LearnVantage sales team as we scale
* You have existing relationships within Accenture's account teams or with the clients

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
### **Come join our Customer Success team!**

 **High velocity, high trust, and high impact with a will to win.**


If those words resonate deeply with you, this could be your next career move. We're seeking someone who leads with humility, pursues audacious goals, and is motivated by meaningful impact on people and the world.


At FutureFit AI, our core mission is to help more people get to better jobs faster and cheaper, with a specific focus on those facing barriers to opportunity. Our work helps resolve the growing issue of economic inequality, ensuring that no one is left behind in the future of work. Our AI\-powered platform brings efficiency and insight to workforce development, replacing outdated systems and unlocking human potential at scale.

You will also own ongoing account management through renewal and expansion.


You will also serve as a key bridge between our customers and our Product and Engineering teams. You will relay customer goals and operational needs internally, while also communicating product capabilities in an accessible, audience\-appropriate language externally.

* Identify opportunities to deepen customer impact, expand platform usage, and strengthen long\-term partnerships.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. jobs.title: LearnVantage Software Sales Account Exec Manager Enterprise Account Management
jobs.description:
Software Sales Manager \| Senior Level \| Full time
Job No. R00353050 \| Multiple Locations
  
**We Are:**


Accenture LearnVantage is Accenture's comprehensive technology learning and training service, built on a $1 billion investment to help the world's leading organizations reskill and upskill their workforces for the AI economy. Launched in March 2024, LearnVantage brings together three industry\-leading training organizations — Udacity (AI, data science, and digital skills), Award Solutions (advanced wireless, 5G, and network technologies), and Ascendient Learning (instructor\-led IT training and vendor\-authorized certifications) — into a single, AI\-powered platform that delivers personalized, outcomes\-driven workforce transformation at enterprise scale.


We sit at the intersection of Accenture's deepest client relationships and the most urgent workforce challenge in the market: helping global enterprises close the AI skills gap at speed and at scale. With Accenture's trust, reach, and account access as our foundation, LearnVantage is positioned to become the defining workforce reinvention partner for the world's most important organizations.

**You Are:**


A strategic, relationship\-driven enterprise seller who knows how to navigate large, complex organizations — both externally with clients and internally within Accenture. You are equally comfortable sitting in an account planning session with a Managing Director as you are presenting a workforce reinvention business case to a client's CHRO. You understand how Accenture operates, how Diamond Account teams think, and how to position LearnVantage as a natural, high\-value extension of the work Accenture is already doing.


You are not a lone wolf. You are a collaborator, an orchestrator, and a trusted partner to the Accenture account teams you work alongside. You know that in this environment, internal influence is as important as external selling — and you have the credibility, patience, and commercial instincts to build both.

**The Work:**

* Embed within Accenture's Diamond Account and strategic account teams as the dedicated LearnVantage sales resource, attending account planning sessions, QBRs, and client meetings to identify and qualify workforce reinvention opportunities within active Accenture engagements
* Build trusted, recurring relationships with Client Account Leads (CALs), Managing Directors, and Accenture industry leads across assigned accounts, establishing yourself as the go\-to LearnVantage expert within the Accenture ecosystem
* Identify the right moment to introduce LearnVantage into active Accenture transformation programs — attaching AI, data, cloud, networking, and certification training to technology implementations, managed services agreements, and change management programs already underway

Base Salary $80,000 annually with a commission program

For more than 70 years, TBC Corporation has been a leader in the mobility industry and one of North America’s largest marketers and distributors of automotive replacement tires through wholesale operations. Additionally, TBC responds to the needs of consumers in search of total car care at nearly 470 franchised tire and automotive service centers under the award\-winning Big O Tires® brand. jobs.title: Brokerage Operations Leader
jobs.description:
**About Gusto**



At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

  

  

All full\-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

  

  

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

**About the Role:**



As the Founding Operations Leader at Gusto's broker\-dealer entity, you will be the primary architect of our in\-house carrying broker\-dealer operations. You aren't here to follow a manual; you are here to write it. You will establish the operational objectives, policies, and work plans from the ground up, ensuring our AI\-native infrastructure meets the highest standards of FINRA/SEC compliance and protect customers' assets. You will report to and partner with the Head of Gusto's broker\-dealer entity. You will build our operational blueprint serving as the bridge between customer impact, technical innovation and regulatory rigor. You will design, oversee and execute essential back\-office functions, focusing on the accurate movement of customer funds, transaction reconciliation and remediation, and reporting required for our broker\-dealer entity. This role requires meticulous attention to detail, a commitment to process excellence and efficiency, and proven ability to lead and scale operational processes.


**About the Team:**



Gusto's broker\-dealer entity, a registered broker\-dealer owned by Gusto Inc, forms the foundation for Gusto to expand our product offerings in retirement and investment. Gusto's broker\-dealer entity acts as the custodian of customers' retirement assets and facilitates money movement and securities transactions, by integrating with the banking rails and clearing rails in the financial system. As a collaborative and technical group, we focus on designing, implementing, and monitoring the proprietary system and processes that meet the evolving demands of the retirement industry and regulatory landscape. You will join a team committed to building operational solutions that scale with Gusto's mission to serve the small business economy.


**Here's what you'll do day\-to\-day:**


* **Establish Operational Architecture:** Author and implement the foundational operational objectives, policies, and procedures for our carrying broker\-dealer. You will design the "0\-to\-1" work plans for money movement and trade clearing that will scale as we grow.
* **Strategic Escalation \& Decision Making:** Serve as the final authority on operational exceptions. You will apply sophisticated judgment to resolve unusual circumstances where no precedent exists, understanding that your decisions directly impact Gusto's results and long\-term regulatory standing. Examples are complex stop\-and\-reissue checks, manual payment releases, ACH reversals, securities settlement breaks, net\-capital calculation discrepancy),
* **Controls \& Audit Governance:** Architect and maintain an operational control environment that meets the rigorous standards comparable to publicly traded companies. You will ensure that Gusto broker\-dealer entity's Internal Controls Over Compliance (ICOC) are robust, evidenced, and audit\-ready by design for every customer transaction, setting a high bar for operational excellence. You will ensure that the transaction data produced is of the highest integrity, as it serves as a critical upstream feed into Gusto's consolidated financial statements. You recognize that the quality of your team's work product directly affects our annual audits conducted by an independent PCAOB auditor, and has far\-reaching implications to Gusto's overall corporate governance.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration, Influence \& Impact:** Orchestrate complex partnerships with Engineering, Product, Legal, Compliance, FinOp, Accounting and FP\&A to build Gusto's first\-of\-its\-kind carrying broker\-dealer. You are an expert at building consensus in sensitive regulatory environments, using data and operational insight to convince cross\-functional stakeholders of the necessary balance between product innovation, execution velocity, uncompromising financial integrity and compliance requirements. You own the operational foundation that unlocks Gusto's opportunities to expand our investment product offerings in 401(k), IRA and more diverse investment account types for Gusto's member community to build wealth
* **Fiscal Responsibility, Direction \& Empowerment:** Although you will start with building a small but mighty AI\-native team, you're responsible for establishing the team's strategic direction, managing costs and demonstrating high ROI on the combination of headcount and AI agents. You're also responsible for performance management and professional growth of the team, setting high bars for excellence and providing the coaching necessary to meet them.

eMazzanti Technologies is a dynamic and growing company dedicated to helping customers achieve their goals through technology. We are seeking a motivated, energetic, and results\-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our team and help drive new business opportunities.

* Opportunity for professional growth and development.

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative - Genius POS
jobs.description:
Every day, Global Payments makes it possible for millions of people to move money between buyers and sellers using our payments solutions for credit, debit, prepaid and merchant services. Our worldwide team helps over 3 million companies, more than 1,300 financial institutions and over 600 million cardholders grow with confidence and achieve amazing results. We are driven by our passion for success and we are proud to deliver best\-in\-class payment technology and software solutions. Join our dynamic team and make your mark on the payments technology landscape of tomorrow.


**Ready to take your career Global?**


Make your mark with one of the biggest names in payments. At Global Payments, you help businesses grow by transforming how they accept and manage payments. As a B2B Outside Sales Representative on the Genius® team, you bring innovative solutions directly to business owners and create a real, measurable impact on their day\-to\-day operations.


You will join a team powered by energy, curiosity, and shared success. You will learn from experienced people leaders, build meaningful connections, and grow your career in a global business that is always evolving. Every conversation you lead and every relationship you build moves the future of commerce forward.


In this role, you’ll drive new business, shape client success and own outcomes that increase revenue, improve operations, and create long\-term value. You will lead the full sales cycle, influence decision\-making and bring the power of Genius® to life for businesses across your market.

**What you’ll own**

* Drive new business growth by creating opportunities through field outreach, digital engagement and local networking
* Own the full sales cycle, turning conversations into revenue and delivering consistent results in your territory
* Build trusted relationships with business owners, positioning yourself as a go\-to advisor who understands their goals
* Deliver compelling, value\-driven presentations that show how Genius® improves operations, increases loyalty and fuels growth
* Shape your territory strategy using market insights, strengthening your pipeline and accelerating deal momentum
* Expand Global Payments’ impact by introducing innovative solutions that help businesses operate smarter and grow faster
* Strengthen long\-term client value by identifying opportunities to expand solutions and deepen relationships
* Spend up to 75% of your time in the field, creating meaningful, face\-to\-face connections that drive results

**What you bring**

* At least one year of success in B2B or business\-to\-consumer (B2C) outside sales, with a track record of delivering results
* Strong ability to communicate, present and negotiate, both in person and virtually
* Confidence building relationships quickly and earning trust with business owners
* A competitive, self\-driven mindset with the energy to achieve and exceed goals
* Ability to think like a client and connect solutions to real business outcomes
* Valid driver’s license and comfort spending up to 75% of your time in the field
* Residence within two hours of the territory to stay connected and responsive

**It’s a bonus if you have**

* A proven ability to upsell and cross\-sell existing merchants on new features, software add\-ons, and hardware upgrades.
* Experience working with the **restaurant** or **retail** industries is a plus.
* Two full years of B2B Outside Sales experience, preferably in fintech, merchant services or Saas.

**Our perks \- what we’ll bring for you**


We know it’s bigger than just your career. It’s your life and your world. That’s why we offer global benefits and programs to support you at every stage. Here’s a taste of what you can expect.

* A competitive salary and benefits package that recognizes your contribution.
* Opportunities to grow your skills and build your career within a global business.
* Access to learning, development and on\-the\-job experiences that expand your expertise.
* A supportive, inclusive team environment where your ideas and input matter.
* Time to give back through community and charity initiatives.
* A global employee assistance program to support your wellbeing.
* Recognition through a global platform that celebrates your achievements.

**https://jobs.globalpayments.com/en/why\-global\-payments/benefits/**

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.


Come and be part of an ever\-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.


Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

Global Payments is an organization that stands against racism, intolerance and injustice in all its forms — one that respects, honors and celebrates the diversity of our team members and the differences among us. jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for **making a difference for small business** in your community? Are you looking for a career with **unlimited income potential**? Is **company culture** important to you? Or maybe you have been thinking about switching career paths and moving into sales?

**NFIB was chosen as a Glassdoor Top 50 Best Places to Work.** A sales career with NFIB provides **money, mission, mobility,** and a culture that fosters teamwork and collaboration. Whether you have some sales experience or are new to sales, NFIB will set you up for success with best\-in\-class training. **A career with NFIB provides a flexible work/life balance while still maintaining full\-time effort in the field.**  

We are seeking individuals who are results\-focused, with an **entrepreneurial spirit**, and exceptional work ethic to prospect, conduct face\-to\-face cold calls, and enroll new members.


***What’s in it for you:**** **W\-2 with full benefits** (medical, dental, vision, matching 401k, and more) \- **eligible after 30 days**
* **Up to 13 weeks** (1,000/wk) **performance\-based training pay** (or commission, whichever is greater)
* **Production\-based weekly commissions, monthly \& quarterly bonuses**
* **Yearly average compensation: $80,000 \- $200,000**
* **40%** of our sales force **earns 6\-figures** with the **top 10%** earning **over 200k**
* **UNCAPPED earning potential** (Straight Commission)
* **Monthly Mileage reimbursement**

***Who we are*****:**

**NFIB is the most trusted advocate for free enterprise**, promoting and protecting the rights of any individual to own, operate, and grow their business. **NFIB's advocacy has a profound impact on shaping public policies** by influencing


decision\-makers, raising awareness, and mobilizing public support. NFIB membership is the mechanism for small business owners to actively contribute to the development of policies that align with their values and concerns. **NFIB has been fighting for independent business owners** for over 80 years. We are the **Voice of Small Business** in Washington, D.C., and in all 50 state capitals. **NFIB is a nonprofit, nonpartisan, and member driven** organization.

  

We educate small business owners through in\-person prospecting (no appointment setting) using NFIB's success\-proven verbatim sales presentation. This is a hunter/closer sales position using an assumptive one\-call close with no account management after the sale. ***What you will be responsible for:**** Meeting small business owners through in\-person prospecting (no appointment setting)
* Memorizing and utilizing NFIB’s proven 5\-minute verbatim sales presentation
* Building quick rapport and delivering an engaging presentation
* Overcoming objections and closing the sale

Processing payment on the spot  
* 

  

***Requirements to win in this role:**** Strong work ethic
* Grit and relentless perseverance
* Self\-starter and ability to stick with a structured, proven sales model
* Desire for ongoing learning
* Quick\-witted, adaptable, and strategic
* Passion for the success of small business
* Sales experience **AND/OR** transferable skills
* Intermediate technical skills


A career with NFIB means being part of a team of truly extraordinary people working to promote and protect small business. You will be impacting your community while taking advantage of our competitive compensation, ongoing training, incentives, and generous benefits package. **Learn more about the NFIB’s culture here:** www.nfib.com/careers


Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Pharmaceutical Field Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Inizio Engage has a long\-standing partnership with a leading Biotechnology company, across Commercial, Patient Solutions and Medical Affairs businesses.


Inizio Engage has partnered with Eisai. We are seeking a performance\-driven Pharmaceutical Field Sales Representative with a strong background in primary care and pharmaceutical sales. This role builds strategic territory business plans, understands customer needs, and drives sales performance for key neurology\-focused targets.


This is your opportunity to join Inizio Engage and represent a top biopharmaceutical company!

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**


We believe great people deserve great support—at work and beyond. That’s why we offer a rewards experience designed to help you thrive personally, professionally, and financially:

* Competitive pay that recognizes your experience, expertise, and impact
* Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage; accrued paid time off; 401(k) with company match; disability and life insurance; and paid maternity and paternity leave
* Company\-paid holidays so you can rest, recharge, and focus on what matters most
* Recognition programs, contests, and awards that celebrate your contributions
* Continuous growth opportunities through learning, leadership development, and career advancement support
* A collaborative culture where your ideas are valued and your work makes a difference


We’re also proud to be recognized for creating an exceptional employee experience:

* Best Place to Work in BioPharma — 2022, 2023, 2025
* Certified Great Place to Work® — 2021, 2023, 2025, 2026


Learn more: https://www.greatplacetowork.com/certified\-company/7003732  

  

**What will you be doing?**

* Demonstrate deep marketplace, therapeutic, product and disease expertise based on a thorough understanding of scientific principles and clinical data, including mechanism of action, indications, efficacy, safety, etc.
* Understand and apply knowledge of the healthcare industry, market trends, regulations, and the neurology market access environment—including payer landscape, reimbursement processes, and patient pathways.
* Build and maintain strong professional relationships with physicians, HCPs, office staff, and other key stakeholders.
* Develop and execute territory business plans based on strategic analysis of market conditions and customer needs.
* Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams to align on goals and deliver results.
* Ask strategic, insightful questions to uncover customer needs and tailor solutions that improve the lives of patients.

**What do you need for this position?**

* Bachelor’s degree required
* 2\+ years of pharmaceutical sales experience required
* Prior experience in Primary Care Provider (PCP) sales required
* Neurology experience a strong plus
* Proven track record of sales success

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Emerald**


Emerald’s talented and experienced teams grow our customers’ businesses 365 days a year with products that create connections, deliver content, and drive commerce. We produce over 140 annual events, create and deliver content through print and digital channels, and power commerce through our seamlessly integrated in\-person and digital platforms and channels. For more information, please visit http://www.emeraldx.com.

  

Emerald is looking for a high\-energy Business Development pro to help grow revenue across our portfolio of trade shows and conferences. You’ll be the person who finds the right companies to talk to, starts the conversation, and qualifies opportunities for our Account Executives to close.

  

If you like digging into research, testing what messaging works, and using tools like Gong and Salesforce to build a pipeline, you’ll fit right in. You’ll help create pipeline through modern outbound prospecting — combining research, signal\-based targeting, and consultative outreach. This is a fast\-paced, “learn by doing” role with clear coaching, measurable goals, and a strong path into an Account Executive career track. This role combines research, signal\-based targeting, and consultative outreach.

 **This position will be based out of our Alpharetta, GA or New York City, NY office.**

 **Why this role matters:** You’ll create the early\-stage pipeline—turning target accounts into real conversations and qualified opportunities that become pipeline and revenue.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Research net\-new exhibitor and sponsor accounts using ZoomInfo industry intelligence, and signal\-based prospecting (intent, trigger events, engagement signals).
* Build targeted lists and run multi\-threaded outreach cadences (email, phone, social) while keeping clean notes and next steps in Salesforce.
* Qualify prospects through short discovery conversations—understanding business pain, priorities, stakeholders, decisions process, and timing so we focus on high\-potential opportunities.
* Create personalized outreach that connects a prospect’s business goals to the value of Emerald’s events (ROI, audience, leads, brand visibility).
* Partner closely with Account Executives for a smooth handoff—sharing research, key contacts, conversation notes, and recommended next steps.
* Collaborate with Marketing and attendee teams to share feedback on lead quality, personas, and campaigns—then adjust targeting and messaging accordingly.
* Stay current on industry trends, competitor events, and emerging categories; bring new ideas for who we should be selling to next.
* Occasionally support the close by stepping in to run pricing/package conversations when needed.

**Qualifications:**

* 0–2 years of experience in sales, customer success, recruiting, fundraising, hospitality, or another role where you had to build relationships and hit goals (internships count).
* Comfortable with outbound outreach (calls \+ email) and willing to practice, iterate, and get better fast.
* Tech savvy: experience using Salesforce (or another CRM) and confidence learning new tools quickly.
* Organized and self\-directed—you can manage a daily outreach plan, follow\-ups, and deadlines without things slipping.
* Strong communication skills: you can write clear, professional messages and speak confidently with new people.
* Be a consultative partner. Apply structured discovery to understand business pain, priorities, stakeholders, and decision process.
* Ability to travel up to 30% (some events require on\-site time).

**Success Metrics:**

* You will be measured on pipeline created, qualified opportunities, conversion, target account penetration, activity effectiveness.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with Gong, ZoomInfo, sales engagement tools, or list\-building tools.
* Comfort with light data analysis (Excel/Google Sheets) to track activity and results.
* Interest in events, media, marketing, or B2B communities—and curiosity about how businesses grow.

 **What success looks like (first 90 days):**

**First 30 Days**  

Learn markets, messaging, systems, and outreach standards.

**60 Days**  

Consistently execute outbound cadence and generate qualified meetings.

**90 Days**  

Create repeatable pipeline contribution and begin influencing targeting and messaging.

 **About Emerald**


At Emerald, we strive to foster a diverse and inclusive community. We actively recruit and champion candidates who bring new perspectives from varied professional backgrounds and experiences, and we are intentional about ensuring a positive hiring experience for everyone. Our job postings don’t contain experience inflation, and most don’t require college degrees. Instead, they’re crafted to focus on outcomes and transferable experiences that are assessed in a structured interview process carried out by trained hiring teams.

 **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS**


Target Compensation: $60,000\-70,000 (Sales Incentive Eligible)


Please note that this range reflects a reasonable estimate of the target compensation for this position. This range may ultimately vary based on a candidate’s qualifications and may be higher where required by applicable law.

  

We offer a competitive benefits package designed to strengthen our employees’ physical and mental health, including unlimited vacation for exempt employees, flexible working locations, 401(k) plan with a company match, medical/dental/vision coverage with inclusive provisions including transgender services and fertility benefits, parental and caregiver leave, dependent, commuter and FSA benefits, professional development programs like Toastmasters, and mental wellness tools.

  

If you need accommodation in our application process or have questions about our posted salary range, please email our Talent Acquisition team at Careers@EmeraldX.com.

We're a wholesale beauty and cosmetics company in the Garment District.

You'll be a point of contact between our office and our overseas factories and the person who makes sure a sample comes back right the second time.

Open sample shipments and compare them against specs. Write clear correction comments (color, packaging, print, fill, component fit) confirmed with our design dept and send them back to the factory.

jobs.description:
**Summary**

Passionate educator wanted to design and lead an engaging, hands\-on after\-school bike mechanics program where urban youth build real\-world STEM skills, confidence, and character in a mission\-driven makerspace environment.

**Role Description**

Imagine channeling your love for teaching and hands\-on STEM into a dynamic, nontraditional environment where kids get excited about real\-world problem\-solving, mechanical thinking, and personal growth. If you’re a passionate educator who thrives on facilitating engaging, project\-based learning, building meaningful connections with students, and watching them light up as they master tangible skills, we want you at Bearings Bike Works.

Bearings is a faith\-based, mission\-driven youth development organization in Atlanta that uses bicycles as a powerful tool to help neighborhood youth build confidence, character, technical skills, and a strong work ethic. Our flagship Skills for Life program is a vibrant drop\-in after\-school space where students learn bike mechanics through immersive, project\-based experiences—disassembling, troubleshooting, building, and riding. It’s education at its most practical and rewarding: no desks in rows, just active learning, collaboration, and the pride of fixing something with their own hands.

This role is perfect for a teacher who:

* Craves facilitating experiential, STEM\-rich learning outside a traditional classroom
* Loves connecting deeply with kids and teens while helping them develop resilience and real\-world competence
* Wants to design and run engaging programs that feel more like a dynamic makerspace than a standard after\-school activity
* Is ready for a purposeful, high\-impact career that still centers on youth growth and mentorship

**JOB SUMMARY**

We’re seeking an energetic, relational, and pedagogically strong Program Specialist to serve as the heart of our Skills for Life program. You’ll design and deliver high\-quality, hands\-on learning experiences, build strong relationships with students and families, and help grow participation through authentic community outreach. This is direct\-service work with real teenagers who need consistent, caring adults in their lives—ideal for someone who wants to keep teaching and facilitating growth in a more flexible, creative, and community\-embedded setting.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Skills for Life Program Design \& Facilitation**

* Lead and continuously improve our best\-in\-class after\-school bike mechanics program, creating a welcoming, well\-organized learning environment with excellent flow from arrival to project work to reflection and wrap\-up.

* Maintain thoughtful records for program evaluation, student progress, and grant reporting while continuously refining processes and documentation.
* Develop communication rhythms with students and families.
* Inspire participants to engage in Bearings’ broader programs and opportunities.

**Student Relationships \& Outreach**

* Build authentic, supportive relationships with youth and their families so they feel seen, valued, and excited to show up consistently.
* Guide students through our skill\-mastery pathway, celebrating growth in technical abilities, confidence, and character—while helping the program exceed goals for enrollment, dosage, and impact.
* Lead creative, grassroots recruitment efforts to bring in new students who would benefit most from this kind of hands\-on, empowering experience.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 2\+ years experience in teaching, mentorship, youth development, summer camp leadership, program coordination, or similar educational roles. *Former classroom teachers (especially elementary, middle, or high school with STEM interest) are strongly encouraged to apply.*
* Passion for hands\-on, experiential learning and comfort facilitating practical skill\-building (bike mechanics experience is a bonus but not required—we value teaching mindset and mechanical curiosity more).
* Strong relationship\-builder who connects easily with urban youth and families.
* Growth\-oriented, organized, and detail\-focused with good writing and creative problem\-solving skills.
* Comfortable with outreach, data tracking, and learning new tools.
* Alignment with our faith\-based mission and high standards for youth character development.

**OTHER KEY INFORMATION**

*Schedule:* Full time, in\-person (no work from home option). In order to serve our students well, the work schedule for this position is Monday\-Thursday 9:30am \- 6:45pm and 9am\-3pm Fridays. *Scheduled based on a 1\-hour unpaid lunch break schedule.* The Bearings team also has a generous Holiday Time Off schedule, including 4\-day summer holiday weekends, a week at Thanksgiving and two weeks at Christmas. Starting team members also have 7 PTO days to use as desired.

jobs.title: Program Specialist, Career Accelerator Program
jobs.description:
**About Bearings Bike Works**

Bearings Bike Works is a faith\-based, mission\-driven organization in Atlanta dedicated to empowering young people through hands\-on learning, mentorship, and career development. We believe hard work is a choice, every job is an opportunity, and that success comes from showing up, taking ownership, and bringing your best—no matter the task. Our Frameworks Career Accelerator Program equips young adults with the technical skills, character, and real\-world experience they need to step confidently into careers and adulthood. Our Skills for Life program brings that same energy to neighborhood youth through hands\-on bike mechanics and project\-based learning. We don’t hand things out. We build people up.

**The Role**

We’re looking for someone who’s ready to get their hands dirty—literally and figuratively. The Frameworks Program Specialist is the operational and relational engine of the program: you’ll keep the space ready, keep participants on task, keep communications moving, and keep the whole thing running so that the Program Manager can go deep on curriculum, case management, and job placement.

But this isn’t just a logistics role. You’ll also be a leader within our Skills for Life program, working alongside another Program Specialist while mentoring Frameworks participants as they coach younger kids and building the kinds of real relationships with neighborhood families that turn a curious middle schooler into a motivated Frameworks applicant two years from now. You’re building a pipeline. You’re building trust. You’re building a career.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Participant Supervision \& Daily Operations**

* Provide direct, day\-to\-day leadership for Frameworks participants—especially those in the early stages of the program—keeping them on task, accountable, and growing
* Lead daily routines, task assignments, and shop responsibilities with clear expectations and consistent follow\-through when standards aren’t met
* Model the work ethic and ownership mindset the program develops in participants: you show up ready, move with purpose, and don’t treat any task as beneath you
* Be the steady, reliable adult presence participants encounter every day—firm, fair, and genuinely invested in who they’re becoming

**After School Program Leadership**

* Work closely alongside the Skills for Life Program Specialist to help ensure the Bearings’ after school program is a success. Specifically, your role will be to lead and support Frameworks participants as they take on coaching and leadership roles within the Skills for Life after\-school program—guiding them through what it means to be a mentor and coach in the room for younger kids
* Build authentic relationships with Skills for Life students (ages 6–18\) and their families: learn their names, show up consistently, and create the kind of trust that makes Bearings a place families send their kids back to
* Identify high\-potential Skills for Life students who could thrive in the Frameworks Career Accelerator Program and cultivate a natural, relational pipeline toward recruitment—no sales pitch needed, just genuine connection over time
* Collaborate with the Skills for Life team on participant engagement, event support, and creating a welcoming, high\-quality program environment

**Facility \& Shop Operations**

* Own the shop space: make sure it’s reset, stocked, and ready before and after every session—because a well\-run space communicates that we take this seriously
* Direct Frameworks participants in cleaning and maintenance responsibilities as part of their program development, teaching ownership of shared spaces
* Keep tools in their place, materials organized, and nothing left to chance—you’re the reason the program looks and runs like a professional operation

**Administrative Support**

* Handle day\-to\-day program admin: printing materials, organizing uniforms, notebooks, and supplies before sessions
* Track participant attendance, maintain organized records, and support data entry to keep the program’s documentation current and accurate
* Support the Program Manager with scheduling, logistics, and operational tasks—and flag when something needs their attention

**Communications \& Coordination**

* Be the first voice participants and families hear: answer inquiries with warmth, professionalism, and clarity
* Schedule participant interviews, orientations, and appointments under the Program Manager’s direction
* Communicate with participants, families, and community partners clearly and consistently—and follow up

**Program \& Event Support**

* Support workshop setup, supply prep, and facilitation logistics as directed
* Help execute program events, career fairs, and community outreach
* Step into whatever the program needs: this role asks for flexibility, creativity, and a whatever\-it\-takes mindset

**Qualifications**

* Genuine passion for working with teenagers and young adults—you actually like the daily challenge of youth work, including the hard conversations
* Comfort being the adult in the room with teenagers: you’re firm but fair, consistent, and not easily rattled
* Strong relational skills—you connect naturally with youth and families from urban communities and build trust over time
* Organized and detail\-oriented: you can manage a space, a schedule, and a stack of materials without dropping the ball
* Clear, professional communicator—comfortable with phones, emails, and in\-person interactions
* 1–2 years of experience in youth work, education, athletics coaching, camp leadership, ministry, or similar—OR a recent grad who’s ready to do something real and is hungry to learn
* Reliable and accountable: you do what you say, and you own it when you fall short
* Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office; comfortable learning new tools
* Bonus: experience in experiential or hands\-on learning environments, bike mechanics, or urban youth nonprofits

jobs.description:
**Position Title****:** Volunteer Programs Specialist


**Department****:** Volunteer Programs \- 1530


**Classification****:** Non\-Exempt / Full\-Time


**Employee Type****:** TSN \- Team Spec FT Non\-exempt


**Direct Report****:** Assistant Manager, Volunteer Programs

  


**Position Summary:**

As part of the Human Resources Team at Georgia Aquarium, Volunteer Programs supports our large, diverse volunteer population. The Volunteer Programs Specialist engages with volunteers and staff to coordinate the program's daily operations, addressing both volunteer and organizational needs. This role supports recruitment, onboarding, recognition, and retention for the general volunteer program, teen volunteers, interns, and employee volunteers.

  



Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, the ability to build trust\-based relationships with a large and diverse volunteer population, and the capacity to manage multiple overlapping projects while meeting deadlines. All Volunteer Programs team members work weekends as part of their regular schedule.

  


**Responsibilities:**



* Provide day\-to\-day support and guidance to general volunteers, teen volunteers, interns, and employee volunteers across all program areas.


* Develop and implement volunteer engagement, retention, and recognition strategies that strengthen the overall volunteer experience and encourage long\-term commitment.


* Manage reward processing and ordering for volunteers, including uniforms, tickets, incentives, and passes, ensuring timely and equitable fulfillment.


* Serve as a primary point of contact for prospective and active volunteers, reviewing applications, answering questions, and processing volunteer paperwork, payments, and background screenings.


* Coordinate and facilitate all volunteer onboarding, including information sessions and orientation, ensuring a consistent and professional experience for all new volunteers.


* Support the training and development of volunteers by facilitating the mentor/mentee program and coordinating ongoing learning opportunities that build volunteer skills and program knowledge


* Plan and execute volunteer engagement initiatives and appreciation events, including monthly office activities, Volunteer Appreciation Week, and the annual Volunteer Appreciation Event.


* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date volunteer records, files, and position descriptions, creating new volunteer positions as needed and conducting periodic audits to ensure data integrity and compliance with organizational standards.


* Collaborate with Aquarium departments to ensure clear understanding of how the Volunteer Programs team supports the overall Georgia Aquarium Strategic Plan; support the broader HR Team as needed.


* Maintain confidentiality of sensitive volunteer information and ensure compliance with applicable regulations, including background screening requirements and labor laws; monitor regulatory changes and recommend policy or procedural updates as needed.


* Perform other duties as workload necessitates.
  


**Qualifications:**



* High School Diploma required, and relevant work experience in Volunteer Administration, Human Resources, Training/Education, Customer Experience, Hospitality, Office Administration, or related field required. Bachelor’s Degree preferred


* High level of attention to detail with excellent organizational and time management skills; ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with frequent interruptions


* Strong communication skills, both written and oral; ability to communicate with a diverse group of individuals effectively and professionally


* Tenacious and self\-motivated, with strong follow\-through to see projects to completion under tight or shifting timelines


* Demonstrated ability to build authentic, trust\-based relationships with a large and diverse volunteer population, as well as with staff and stakeholders across the organization


* Works well independently and as part of a team; partners effectively with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders


* Proficient with Microsoft Office Products (Word, Outlook, Excel, OneNote, Planner, Forms); Familiarity with Volgistics or other volunteer database systems; experience with Tessitura a plus


* Proactively solves problems and leads them to positive outcomes


* Familiarity with HR practices and regulations; demonstrated awareness of guest service and commitment to the guest experience

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; talk or hear; taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. jobs.description:
**Are you passionate about delivering exceptional service and building professional relationships with law enforcement agencies?**

**Would you enjoy a role where your attention to detail and commitment to accuracy help insurance customers receive critical accident\-related media efficiently and securely?**

**About the Business**

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Insurance vertical, we provide customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. Our insurance risk solutions help drive better data\-driven decisions across the insurance policy lifecycle, all while reducing risk. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at https://risk.lexisnexis.com/insurance


**About the Role**

This position is part of the Photo team responsible for supporting insurance company customers by researching and coordinating with law enforcement agencies to obtain accident\-related media. You will play an important role in processing, securing, and distributing digital evidence while ensuring service levels, accuracy, and compliance requirements are met. This role is well suited to someone who is organized, detail\-oriented, and comfortable working with sensitive content in a production\-focused environment.


This role will begin as 5 days in\-office (Duluth, GA) and eventually move into a hybrid work environment, with manager approval.


**Responsibilities**

* Contact and research law enforcement agencies to facilitate the retrieval of accident\-related media.
* Establish and maintain communication with police departments regarding media requests and order statuses.
* Process, verify, and distribute media associated with police reports to insurance company customers.
* Review and manage digital evidence, including potentially graphic images related to motor vehicle accidents.
* Accurately document request activity and maintain production standards and service level expectations.
* Support media fulfillment operations through secure handling, encryption, and distribution of digital files.
* Prepare digital media for customer delivery, including copying files to encrypted USB devices.
* Generate shipping labels and coordinate outbound deliveries through UPS.
* Assist with incoming mail processing and other operational support functions as needed.
* Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and data handling requirements when working with sensitive law enforcement materials.

Preferred Skills \& Competencies


* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to build professional relationships with law enforcement personnel.
* Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in a production environment.
* Comfort working with sensitive and occasionally graphic content.
* Ability to meet productivity, quality, and turnaround time goals.

**Requirements**

* Required: Minimum Education: High School Diploma or GED
* Required: Able to work Monday\-Friday
* Required: Able to meet production metrics.
* Highly organized and works well in team environment.
* Experience in criminal justice, insurance claims, call center and/or police departments a plus.

U.S. National Base Pay Range: $36,700 \- $61,300\. Geographic differentials may apply in some locations to better reflect local market rates.

Chandler Law is seeking a professional, organized, and service\-minded Client Services Coordinator to guide prospective and current clients through each step of their experience with our firm.

As a Client Services Coordinator, you will be an important part of each client’s experience with Chandler Law. Often serving as a client’s first point of contact, you will help build trust from the very beginning and provide attentive, professional support throughout their relationship with the firm. By coordinating communications, meetings, document signings, and ongoing services, you will help ensure every client receives a seamless and personalized experience.

Chandler Law helps Georgia families plan for their futures and protect the people and legacies that matter most to them. * Assist attorneys with administrative correspondence and post\-appointment action items

* Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills
* Associate degree in business administration, communications, legal studies, or a related field preferred; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered
* Previous experience in a law firm, professional\-services firm, or estate\-planning environment preferred but not required

Full\-time employees become eligible for the firm’s benefit offerings following a 90\-day waiting period, with coverage beginning on the first day of the applicable month. Current benefits include:

* Firm\-paid dental insurance through Humana

* Paid time off in accordance with the firm’s applicable employee policies

This position is based primarily in a professional office environment and involves regular in\-person interaction with clients, attorneys, notaries, witness

jobs.title: Inside Sales and Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About The Erosion Company**


The Erosion Company (TEC), headquartered in Woodstock, Georgia, is a leading nationwide erosion control specialty contractor serving the construction, infrastructure, and renewable energy industries. With more than 25 years of experience, over 500 employees, and 120\+ crews operating across the United States, TEC provides turnkey solutions including erosion and sediment control, stormwater management, site compliance, hydroseeding, remediation, and environmental services. Having supported more than 150,000 projects, TEC is recognized for its ability to deliver comprehensive, one\-stop\-shop services that help clients maintain environmental compliance, avoid costly delays and fines, and keep projects on schedule. The company's strengths include rapid emergency response, operational flexibility to support projects of all sizes, certified field management teams, and a commitment to providing reliable, compliant solutions nationwide.

 **POSITION SUMMARY**


The Inside Sales and Marketing Coordinator is responsible for supporting business development, customer engagement, marketing initiatives, and lead generation efforts for The Erosion Company (TEC). This position serves as a key link between operations, sales, customers, and marketing by identifying new business opportunities, maintaining customer relationships, coordinating marketing activities, and tracking sales performance. The ideal candidate is highly organized, customer\-focused, detail\-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

 **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Inside Sales**

* Generate and qualify sales leads through outbound calls, emails, networking, and customer outreach.
* Prospect and develop relationships with contractors, developers, municipalities, and other potential customers.
* Maintain ongoing communication with prospective and existing customers to identify project opportunities and support business growth.
* Schedule meetings and appointments for Regional Sales Managers, Branch Managers, and Business Development personnel.
* Assist in preparing proposals, bid packages, presentations, and customer communications.
* Track customer interactions, sales activities, and opportunities within the company's CRM system.
* Follow\-up on quotes, bids, proposals, and customer inquiries to increase conversion rates and drive revenue growth.
* Support customer retention through proactive communication and relationship management.
* Monitor market trends, project activity, and competitive intelligence to identify new business opportunities and provide insights to leadership.

 **Marketing \& Communications**

* Coordinate marketing campaigns to support business growth and brand awareness.
* Assist with developing marketing materials such as brochures, presentations, email campaigns, and promotional items.
* Coordinate customer events, trade shows, industry conferences, and networking opportunities.
* Support recruiting marketing initiatives by promoting TEC's employer brand, website content and marketing.
* Ensure all marketing materials align with TEC branding standards.

 **Administrative \& Reporting**

* Maintain accurate customer, prospect, and lead databases.

jobs.title: Studio Client and Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
Studio Client \& Social Media Coordinator

**SPRAY STUDIO® \| Sandy Springs / Atlanta**

SPRAY STUDIO® is looking for someone who knows how to run a front desk, loves the beauty industry, understands social media beyond just posting a cute photo — and can bring all three together.

This role sits right in the middle of the SPRAY STUDIO experience. You’ll be one of the first people our clients see when they walk in, the person keeping the studio organized behind the scenes, and part of the voice they see when they find us online.

We’re looking for someone with **real front desk experience in the beauty industry AND professional experience managing social media for a business or brand.**

Both matter.

You don’t necessarily need to come from a spray tanning studio, but you should genuinely enjoy the sunless tanning and beauty space. Salon, hair, skincare, med spa, cosmetics, boutique beauty or similar experience can translate really well.

If you already know your way around spray tanning? Even better.

FRONT DESK \+ CLIENT EXPERIENCE

You’ll help keep the studio moving while making sure every client feels taken care of from the minute they walk in.

* Welcome clients and create a warm, polished studio experience
* Manage appointments, reschedules, cancellations and client questions
* Answer phones, texts, emails and studio messages
* Handle check\-in, checkout, payments, memberships, retail purchases and rebooking
* Manage appointment flow during busy days
* Get to know our regular clients and help build lasting relationships
* Handle client concerns or service issues professionally
* Communicate with artists and the rest of the studio team throughout the day
* Keep the front desk and client areas organized, stocked and ready

We move fast. You should be someone who can have a client in front of you, a phone ringing, an appointment changing and a team member asking you a question — and still keep it together.

SOCIAL MEDIA \+ BRAND SUPPORT

We want someone who understands that **managing social media is different from occasionally posting on the company Instagram.**

You should have experience helping manage a brand or business account and understand how to keep a social presence active, consistent and actually interesting.

You’ll help:

* Plan and maintain a consistent social media calendar
* Create and publish Instagram content, Stories and Reels
* Capture photos and short\-form video in the studio
* Write captions that sound like SPRAY STUDIO
* Highlight products, tans, artists, clients, promotions and what’s happening in the studio
* Monitor comments and DMs and help keep engagement timely
* Identify trends that make sense for our brand
* Track basic performance and understand what content is connecting
* Help keep the brand consistent across what clients experience online and in person

You should be comfortable picking up a phone and creating content — not waiting for someone to tell you exactly what to photograph, film or post every time.

YOU’LL PROBABLY LOVE THIS ROLE IF...

You genuinely like the beauty industry.

You understand why someone cares about the difference between an okay tan and a GREAT tan.

You notice when the front desk doesn’t look right.

You remember clients.

You can talk to people without sounding scripted.

You know your way around Instagram.

You understand what makes a Reel watchable.

You’re organized enough to follow a content calendar but creative enough to know when something happening in the studio needs to be captured right now.

And you like working somewhere that is fun, social and fast\-paced without being chaotic or unprofessional.

WHAT WE NEED

**Front Desk Experience — Required**

Previous experience working a busy front desk in a salon, spa, tanning studio, med spa, beauty retailer or similar appointment\-based beauty business.

You should already understand appointment management, client communication, checkout, rebooking and the pace of a busy beauty environment.

**Social Media Experience — Required**

Previous responsibility for managing social media for a business, brand or organization.

We want to hear about the accounts you’ve actually helped manage, what you were responsible for and the types of content you created.

Experience with Instagram Stories, Reels and short\-form video is strongly preferred.

**Beauty Industry Experience — Strongly Preferred**

Experience in tanning, hair, skincare, salons, spas, med spas, cosmetics, beauty retail or another beauty\-focused environment.

**Sunless/Tanning Knowledge — Strongly Preferred**

You don’t have to be a spray tan artist, but you should understand the industry, be interested in learning our products and services, and genuinely connect with the SPRAY STUDIO brand.

ALSO HELPFUL

* Booker, Vagaro, Mindbody, Boulevard or similar booking systems
* Canva
* Instagram and Meta tools
* Google Workspace
* Basic Excel/Google Sheets
* Retail or product sales
* Content planning
* Customer service and client recovery

THE PERSONALITY FIT

We’re a small, collaborative team, so how you work matters.

We’re looking for someone who is:

* Friendly and naturally comfortable with people
* Confident without needing to be the center of attention
* Detail\-oriented
* Dependable
* Quick on their feet
* Comfortable taking initiative
* Creative but organized
* Professional while still having personality
* Excited to learn the SPRAY STUDIO way of doing things

We care about giving clients an experience that feels fun, welcoming and genuinely good from start to finish.

SCHEDULE

This is an **in\-person position at our Sandy Springs / Atlanta studio.**

Flexibility for daytime, evening and weekend shifts is required based on studio needs.

PAY \+ PERKS

**$23–$25/hour, based on experience**

Plus:

* Paid training and mentorship
* Complimentary spray tans
* Generous product discounts
* Bonus opportunities and performance incentives
* Opportunity to grow as the studio and brand continue to grow

WANT TO FAST\

**About Emerald**

  

Emerald’s talented and experienced teams grow our customers’ businesses 365 days a year with products that create connections, deliver content, and drive commerce. We produce over 140 annual events, create and deliver content through print and digital channels, and power commerce through our seamlessly integrated in\-person and digital platforms and channels. For more information, please visit http://www.emeraldx.com.

  

Emerald is seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Event Operations Manager to lead the planning and execution of tradeshows and events. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with internal teams and external partners to manage budgets, logistics, vendor relationships, and onsite operations with a strong focus on efficiency and delivering exceptional experiences.

  

The Event Operations Manager collaborates extensively with internal teams and external partners to manage spending, contracts, onsite design, logistics, and show collateral. They ensure all stakeholders remain informed as plans evolve and oversee all preplanning and onsite operational aspects while maintaining strong relationships with partners and Emerald personnel.

  

The ideal candidate is an organized, collaborative leader who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and embodies Emerald’s values: people, leadership, agility, commitment, and excellence.

 **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Event Planning, Coordination, and Evaluation**

* Plan and execute all assigned events and support others as needed
* Develop show production timelines to ensure proper and timely coordination of all event components
* Facilitate pre\-show and post\-show event meetings and participate in weekly show team meetings
* Develop operations post\-event assessment to ensure feedback document issues that inform future planning

**Budgeting \& Financial Management**

* Develop and maintain event budgets and expenses, including identifying cost saving measures related to operating expenses
* Manage budget revisions and monthly accruals
* Maintain payment schedules and contractual deposits
* Process vendor invoices for payment and reconcile credit card expenses in alignment with monthly deadlines

**Vendor Management \& Contracting**

* Create RFPs for ancillary vendors, review and analyze proposals and provide recommendations to leadership for vendor selection
* Manage SOWs and schedules for core show partners, such as first aid, security and cleaning
* Review facility and hotel contracts as required

**Floorplan, Logistics \& Production**

* Submit and monitor exhibit hall, registration, and special event floor plans.
* Coordinate all expo logistics, show design concepts, and signage with the General Service Contractor
* Manage signage plans, graphic production, and onsite placement accuracy in collaboration with the Marketing and Creative teams
* Oversee the production of the exhibitor service manuals, which outline all pertinent information, rules, and regulations for the show
* Manage booth approvals and rule enforcement with exhibitors
* Work closely with Sales and Marketing to development Sponsorship opportunities and manage their fulfillment costs and logistics
* Plan and manage lounges and specialty areas on the show floor
* Collaborate internally on housing requirements for staff, VIP, speakers, etc. as required
* Actively manage show housing in coordination with the housing agency and work collaboratively to ensure attrition is avoided

**Conference Programs \& Special Events**

* Contract venues/spaces, manage logistics, and oversee execution of special events
* Assist with the conference program as directed, including supporting audio\-visual contracting/coordination, meeting room setups, and related signage, etc.

**Onsite Execution \& Show Operations**

* Lead onsite operations across move\-in, show staging, and move\-out, ensuring timelines, safety standards, and service requirements are met
* Manage onsite vendors and coordinate with venue teams and Emerald colleagues to problem solve in real\-time
* Maintain exhibitor, sponsor, and attendee experience standards through active floor management and problem resolution
* Ensure compliance with facility regulations, union requirements, and emergency procedures throughout the event
* Document issues and opportunities for future events to be shared in post\-event assessment
* Ensure a positive and collaborative spirit is maintained in all interactions with colleagues, partners, and customers

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3\+ years of experience in event operations
* Strong understanding of event planning principles, requirements, and procedures
* High emotional intelligence and calm under pressure
* Ability to stay highly organized and efficient while handling multiple shows with overlapping planning and execution cycles
* Proven experience leading a team and managing external partners
* Demonstrated ability to create and manage event budgets
* Proficient in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook; SmartSheet and A2Z experience a plus
* Ability to travel up to 50% including extended time on show site for move\-in, show execution, and move\-out

**Client Experience Coordinator**  

**Waxing the City – Alpharetta \& Cumming**  

**Create the Experience. Build Relationships. Help Us Grow.**  

Waxing the City is looking for an outgoing, energetic, and highly personable **Client Experience Coordinator** to support our Alpharetta and Cumming studios.  

This isn’t just a front desk position.  

We’re looking for someone who loves people, genuinely enjoys talking with clients, and understands that **every interaction is an opportunity to create an amazing experience**.  

You’ll be one of the faces of our brand—welcoming clients, building relationships, supporting our Cerologists, helping keep the studios running smoothly, and finding creative ways to introduce more people in our community to Waxing the City.  

The ideal person is someone who brings **positive energy wherever they go**. You’re friendly, polished, organized, comfortable starting conversations, and willing to jump in wherever you’re needed.  

**This position supports both our Alpharetta and Cumming locations. Candidates must have reliable transportation and be able and willing to work at both studios.**  

**What You’ll Do**  

**Create an Amazing Client Experience**  

Our clients are at the center of everything we do.  

* Warmly welcome clients and make them feel comfortable from the moment they walk through the door.
* Build genuine relationships with our clients and get to know our regulars.
* Help clients schedule appointments and find services that fit their needs.
* Answer phones, texts, and client questions with warmth and professionalism.

* Learn our services, products, promotions, and brand so you can confidently talk about them with clients.
* Help create a fun, welcoming atmosphere in the studio.
* Support studio events and promotions.
* Represent Waxing the City professionally both inside the studio and in the community.
* Look for opportunities to turn a first\-time visitor into a loyal Waxing the City client.

**Help Us Market \& Grow**  

You don’t need to be a professional marketer—but you should be **creative, social, and excited about helping a local business grow.**  

* Help create fun and engaging social media content.
* Capture photos and videos of what’s happening in the studios.
* Help promote new services, products, team members, and special offers.
* Assist with local events, partnerships, and community outreach.
* Help distribute marketing materials and connect with nearby businesses.
* Bring us ideas! We love someone who sees an opportunity and says, **“We should try this!”**

**Support Our Studio Team**

* Support our Cerologists throughout the day.

* Assist with retail displays and inventory.
* Help keep client areas stocked and presentation\-ready.
* Communicate important client information to the appropriate team members.
