**Who We’re Looking For**  

Our ideal Client Experience Coordinator is:  

* **Outgoing, warm, friendly, and genuinely great with people**
* Someone with a **sparkling personality and positive energy**
* Comfortable talking to new people and starting conversations
* Passionate about providing exceptional customer service
* Dependable, organized, and detail\-oriented
* Comfortable answering phones and communicating professionally with clients
* Confident recommending products, services, and memberships
* Creative and interested in social media and local marketing
* A team player who notices what needs to be done and jumps in
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced environment
* Excited about the beauty, skincare, wellness, or self\-care industry
* **Able and willing to work at both our Alpharetta and Cumming locations**

Experience in **salon, spa, beauty, wellness, hospitality, retail, fitness, customer service, or another client\-focused environment** is a plus.  

Previous management experience is **not required**. We’re much more interested in finding someone with the **right personality, work ethic, energy, and desire to grow.**  

**This Could Be a Great Fit If…**  

You’re the person who remembers someone’s name after meeting them once.  

You notice when a client walks through the door and immediately make them feel welcome.  

You love recommending a product or service because you genuinely think someone will love it.  

You enjoy taking a quick video for Instagram, meeting people at a community event, helping a coworker when things get busy, and finding little ways to make someone’s day better.  

Most importantly, you understand that **great customer service isn’t a task—it’s how you treat people.**  

**Why Waxing the City?**  

At Waxing the City, what we do goes beyond hair removal. We help people feel comfortable, confident, and great about themselves.  

We’re looking for someone who wants to help us create that experience every single day.  

If you’re energetic, people\-focused, creative, dependable, and looking for a role where you can **build relationships, have fun, and make a real impact on a growing local business**, we’d love to meet you.

Additionally, this individual provides support to the *Director, Engineering Solutions* and is responsible for actively engaging with target systems accounts and acting as the customer’s trusted partner in the sales process and through delivery of the sold product.

* **Systems Account Management** \- The systems salesperson should build and maintain relationships with existing and target accounts.
	+ Regular touchpoints (phone, virtual meetings, site\-visits)
	+ Understanding customer’s needs
	+ Providing proactive solutions
	+ Addressing any concerns
	+ Provide ongoing recommendations for additional services.
* **Customer Assessments (Data Collection) \-** The systems salesperson will assess the specific needs of the customer and collect necessary data to generate a systems solution.
	+ Understanding the customer’s current operations
	+ Identifying pain points or inefficiencies
	+ Strategizing how to solve a customer’s challenges or improving processes.
* **Solution Proposals** \- Based on the collected data and the needs assessment, the systems salesperson should work with an assigned solutions engineer and (my role) to develop a customized solution proposal. This involves determining.
	+ System Flow
	+ Product Selection
	+ Cost savings, operational efficiency, and improved safety measures
* **Customer Proposals** \- The systems salesperson will work with the systems team (solutions engineering, my role, and implementation) to provide accurate proposals to the customer.
	+ Process Flows
	+ Pricing
	+ Implementation Schedules
	+ ROI Calculations
* **Order Process Management** \- The salesperson is responsible for managing the ordering process.
	+ Order Submission to Sales Support
	+ Management of Vendor Quotes
	+ Coordinating with internal teams and vendors for handoff to Project Management
	+ Change Orders
* **Systems Delivery** \- The systems salesperson will stay engaged in the delivery of the material handling system and ensure the installation and implementation are handled to the customer’s satisfaction. The systems salesperson will also participate in the site acceptance testing with the project management team to certify all criteria of the sold system are fulfilled.
* **Systems Aftermarket Support** \- The systems salesperson will work with the local branch to provide an aftermarket strategy to the customer during the sales process.
	+ Develop a customized site aftermarket plan to include parts and service support that will be transitioned to the operations team at delivery.
* Other duties as assigned.

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

jobs.title: Regional Account Manager - Southeast
jobs.description:
**Craft\-Bilt Manufacturing Co.**

***Enthusiastic Employees...Flawless Performance...Delighted Customers!***




**6\+ Weeks of Paid Days Off in First Full Year**

**Yes, you read that correctly. We just believe in a work\-life balance. With 15 days of paid time off (PTO) and 16 paid holidays, you will have a total of 31 days off (6\+ weeks) in your first full year with us.**




**But wait, there's more...**

**We add an extra 5 days of PTO in your second year for a total of 36 days off (7\+ weeks). Almost two months of paid days off.**




A little about Craft\-Bilt:


We believe life is better outside. Fresh air and natural light aren't just enjoyable, they're essential for our mental and physical well\-being. Who really wants to be stuck inside under fluorescent lights, breathing recycled air, when we could be outside making real connections with friends and neighbors?


We are a mid\-sized, family\-owned manufacturing company that brings America outside. At Craft\-Bilt Manufacturing Company, we design and build high\-quality, affordable home improvements that help homeowners make the most of their outdoor spaces.


Our products include retractable awnings, sunrooms, decking, and railings.




**Important Requirement: This is a road warrior position. You must be comfortable traveling extensively and staying overnight Monday through Thursday each week to visit client sites and support customer needs in the field.**




**Salary: $75,000 annually plus commission. You will receive 2\.5% commission on all sales growth above your annual baseline.**




**What You'll Do:**

* Serve as a key point of contact for assigned customers, managing relationships and ensuring their needs are met
* Build and maintain strong, long\-lasting relationships with existing customers and key decision\-makers
* Develop trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and identify opportunities to strengthen and expand partnerships
* Prospect for new customers and business opportunities through networking, referrals, industry research, and targeted outreach
* Identify and pursue opportunities to grow existing accounts through upselling, cross\-selling, and expanded product offerings
* Develop new accounts by understanding customer needs, presenting solutions, and guiding prospects through the sales process
* Maintain a strong understanding of our products, markets, competitors, and industry trends to identify potential opportunities
* Ensure the timely and successful delivery of our solutions according to customer needs and objectives
* Clearly communicate the progress of sales initiatives, customer opportunities, and account activity to internal and external stakeholders
* Forecast and track key sales and account metrics, including sales results, pipeline activity, new business, and customer retention
* Follow up consistently with prospects and customers to move opportunities forward and maintain strong relationships
* Resolve customer issues and complaints quickly and effectively while identifying opportunities to strengthen the relationship

**What We're Looking For:**

* Proven work experience in account management, business development, sales, outside sales, or a related role
* Demonstrated ability to develop new business while maintaining and growing existing customer relationships
* Strong prospecting, networking, negotiation, presentation, and closing skills
* Ability to communicate, present, and influence effectively at all levels of an organization
* Confidence in juggling multiple accounts, prospects, and priorities while switching gears quickly
* Excellent listening and relationship\-building skills with a customer\-focused approach
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Self\-motivated and comfortable taking initiative and working independently
* Willingness and ability to travel overnight Monday through Thursday every week


At Craft\-Bilt, we believe our employees are our greatest asset. We provide a fantastic workplace, excellent benefits, and a role where you can truly make an impact.


Ready to join our team? Apply today!

jobs.title: LearnVantage Software Sales Account Exec Manager Enterprise Account Management
jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Accenture LearnVantage is Accenture's comprehensive technology learning and training service, built on a $1 billion investment to help the world's leading organizations reskill and upskill their workforces for the AI economy. Launched in March 2024, LearnVantage brings together three industry\-leading training organizations — Udacity (AI, data science, and digital skills), Award Solutions (advanced wireless, 5G, and network technologies), and Ascendient Learning (instructor\-led IT training and vendor\-authorized certifications) — into a single, AI\-powered platform that delivers personalized, outcomes\-driven workforce transformation at enterprise scale.


We sit at the intersection of Accenture's deepest client relationships and the most urgent workforce challenge in the market: helping global enterprises close the AI skills gap at speed and at scale. With Accenture's trust, reach, and account access as our foundation, LearnVantage is positioned to become the defining workforce reinvention partner for the world's most important organizations.

**You Are:**


A strategic, relationship\-driven enterprise seller who knows how to navigate large, complex organizations — both externally with clients and internally within Accenture. You are equally comfortable sitting in an account planning session with a Managing Director as you are presenting a workforce reinvention business case to a client's CHRO. You understand how Accenture operates, how Diamond Account teams think, and how to position LearnVantage as a natural, high\-value extension of the work Accenture is already doing.


You are not a lone wolf. You are a collaborator, an orchestrator, and a trusted partner to the Accenture account teams you work alongside. You know that in this environment, internal influence is as important as external selling — and you have the credibility, patience, and commercial instincts to build both.

**The Work:**

* Embed within Accenture's Diamond Account and strategic account teams as the dedicated LearnVantage sales resource, attending account planning sessions, QBRs, and client meetings to identify and qualify workforce reinvention opportunities within active Accenture engagements
* Build trusted, recurring relationships with Client Account Leads (CALs), Managing Directors, and Accenture industry leads across assigned accounts, establishing yourself as the go\-to LearnVantage expert within the Accenture ecosystem
* Identify the right moment to introduce LearnVantage into active Accenture transformation programs — attaching AI, data, cloud, networking, and certification training to technology implementations, managed services agreements, and change management programs already underway
* Lead executive\-level discovery and solution presentations with client C\-suite stakeholders (CIO, CHRO, CDO, CEO, CLO), positioned as a strategic LearnVantage partner rather than a training vendor add\-on
* Design comprehensive LearnVantage workforce solutions — drawing on LearnVantage AI programs, Award Solutions 5G and network training, and Ascendient Learning IT certification — that complement and accelerate the technology transformations Accenture is delivering
* Present value\-selling business cases that connect LearnVantage investments to measurable client outcomes: AI capability development, technology adoption speed, workforce productivity, talent retention, and long\-term competitive readiness
* Navigate Accenture's internal commercial processes — including CCI considerations, Accenture Funding mechanisms, and co\-investment structures — with the knowledge and credibility to advocate for LearnVantage's commercial interests while maintaining strong internal relationships
* Manage LearnVantage pipeline across all assigned Accenture accounts with disciplined CRM hygiene, accurate forecasting, and regular visibility for both LearnVantage and Accenture leadership
* Convert Accenture\-introduced opportunities into closed, contracted LearnVantage engagements and expand those engagements over time into multi\-year, multi\-solution workforce partnerships
* Serve as the voice of the client and the CAL back to LearnVantage's product, curriculum, and go\-to\-market teams — surfacing emerging skill gaps, deal structure needs, and market opportunities that improve LearnVantage's relevance within the Accenture ecosystem


Travel to client sites and Accenture offices as required to support strategic account pursuits; travel estimated at 30–50% depending on assigned accounts


  

**Here's What You Need:**

* Minimum of 7 years of experience in business development, account management, sales leadership, or new logo acquisition in a consulting, technology, or professional services environment.
* Demonstrated track record of originating and closing significant net new business in mid\-market or multi\-subsidiary environments, preferably $500K\+ ARR deals or more
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

**Bonus Points If:**

* You have direct experience with Accenture's account structure, including familiarity with Diamond Accounts, CAL/MD relationships, and Accenture's internal commercial processes (CCI, Accenture Funding, co\-investment)
* You have experience selling corporate learning, AI and digital skills platforms, managed learning services, IT certification training, or workforce technology into large enterprise accounts
* You have familiarity with any LearnVantage solution area — AI/ML (Udacity), advanced wireless and 5G (Award Solutions), or instructor\-led IT certification (Ascendient Learning)
* You have experience building and scaling a co\-sell motion within a large partner or alliance ecosystem
* You have experience leading or mentoring sales talent and an interest in helping build the LearnVantage sales team as we scale
* You have existing relationships within Accenture's account teams or with the clients

jobs.title: Junior Account Manager
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

**About Us**  

YouLend is a leading global embedded finance platform helping businesses access fast, flexible funding through partners like eBay, Amazon, Grubhub, Shift4, and Stripe.  

As we rapidly expand across the US, we're looking for a motivated **Junior Account Manager** to join our growing Atlanta Sales team. This is a fantastic opportunity to launch your sales career at one of the world's fastest\-growing fintech companies.  

In this hands\-on role, you'll work directly with merchants every day, build valuable sales and relationship management skills, and grow your career in a fast\-paced, high\-impact environment. If you're ambitious, proactive, and excited by the opportunity to make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

As a Junior Account Manager, you’ll play a key role in supporting our sales operations, nurturing client relationships, and helping merchants across the country access the funding they need to grow.* Proactively manage a portfolio of accounts, monitoring performance, identifying growth opportunities, and providing insights to help merchants succeed.
* Handle inbound and outbound communications with professionalism and care — including calls, emails, and platform messages — ensuring all interactions are accurate and timely.
* Collaborate closely with internal teams such as Sales, Risk, and Operations to resolve merchant inquiries or issues efficiently and effectively.
* Support merchants through renewals, upsell opportunities, and product education, always balancing customer needs with business objectives.
* Maintain detailed and accurate records of all merchant interactions, activities, and account updates across internal systems and CRM tools.
* Demonstrate strong communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills to build trust and deliver positive outcomes.
* Prioritize workload effectively to manage a high volume of accounts while maintaining accuracy and a customer\-first mindset.
* Bring commercial awareness, problem\-solving ability, and enthusiasm for working with SMEs in a dynamic fintech environment.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise**

  

**The ideal candidate will have the following skillset:*** Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential.
* Proven ability to work effectively under pressure and meet tight deadlines. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (both written and verbal). Demonstrated problem\-solving ability and initiative.
* Team\-oriented with a collaborative approach to work.
* Positive attitude, reliability, and a strong work ethic. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite; experience with financial systems or CRM tools is a plus. Previous experience in a funding, finance, or operations role is an advantage but not required.

**Desirable Skills:*** A target\-driven mindset with a strong interest in sales and commercial success.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence interacting over phone and email.
* Comfortable using Microsoft Excel and working with data.
* A customer\-first attitude with a passion for helping small businesses succeed.

  

### **Job Benefits**

 **Why join YouLend?*** Award\-Winning Workplace: YouLend has been recognized as one of the “Best Places to Work in 2024 and 2025” by the Sunday Times for being a supportive, diverse, and rewarding workplace.
* Award\-Winning Fintech: YouLend has been recognized as a “Top 250 Fintech Worldwide” company by CNBC.

  

**It’s just getting fun:*** We have developed powerful solutions, won some significant partnerships, and are growing at a rapid pace.

But the global opportunity is still massive, and YouLend is a raw organization where we are only just getting started.  
* 

**Lots of upsides:*** High\-growth (\>100% growth during 2022 and 2023\), so clear outlook to compensation (bonus or share option appreciation) and career growth (through growth with the business).
* Well\-capitalized with supportive private equity backing.

Part of Banking Circle Group with a fully licensed Luxembourg bank, which can provide a balance sheet and support European expansion in otherwise complex regulated markets.  
* 

**Motivating work environment:*** A high\-quality team that pushes each other to succeed through direct feedback and aligned incentives.
* Strong and transparent team culture, we have each other’s backs.
* Independent work environment where results matter.

Data\-driven culture and emphasis on speed (anti\-red tape).  
* 

**We offer comprehensive benefits package that includes:*** Health Care Coverage. YouLend covers 80%; employee contribution is 20% of the premium.
* Medical Plan (medical insurance and prescription drug coverage)\- Choice of 5 different plans through United Healthcare.
* Dental plan coverage
* Vision plan coverage
* Benefits can be for: Employee only; Employee \& Spouse; Employee \& Child; Employee \& Family
* Retirement \- 401K match. Employee match $1 for $1 up to 5% of salary.
* Basic Life \& AD\&D Insurance.
* International travel insurance covered if traveling abroad for work purposes.
* Paid Time Off (PTO)\- 20 working days (4 weeks) \+ US public holidays
* Paid Office Parking

  

### **About YouLend**


YouLend is a rapidly growing FinTech that is the preferred embedded financing platform for many of the world’s leading e\-commerce platforms, tech companies, and Payment Service Providers. Our software platform enables our partners to extend their value proposition by offering flexible financing products in their own branding, to their merchant base, without capital at risk. We are owned by the leading Private Equity company, EQT, and have grown \+100% yearon\-year since 2020\. We are headquartered in London, UK, but are also present in several European countries as well as the United States where we service our partners, including eBay, Amazon, Just Eat, Shopify, and Stripe

Medical, dental, and vision coverage

Formal training and development program

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
We’re seeking a positive, personable Account Manager who can offer high\-quality, dependable support to both our operations staff and sales team and help improve our efficiency. The Account Manager will need to be ready to assist in the continued growth and development of our boutique firm’s portfolio of clients. Through our ongoing growth initiatives and strategic affiliate relationships, our firm has grown consistently over the past 21\+ years. Unique concepts and original approaches to problems help us to differentiate ourselves from the competition.


Our operations staff and sales team need an infusion of talent to help drive our firm’s next phase of progress. We are seeking a highly motivated, self\-disciplined individual with integrity to join our team. If you are a strong communicator who demonstrates professionalism and you are interested in applying your skills to facilitate Agile’s robust growth, we encourage you to apply today.


Applicants must have the ability to come into our Norcross office a minimum of 5 days per week, but the hours are flexible, and we are willing to work with your schedule to develop a routine that works for you.


You’ll connect with new people, tackle tough problems, and raise the bar on an excellent customer experience. We welcome applicants who are interested in upward mobility, a positive work environment, and can’t wait to get started!

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Base pay of $22\.50 per hour
* Health insurance for full\-time
* Company 401(k) program, with employer matching for full\-time
* Company profit\-sharing program for full\-time
* Paid vacation and holidays

 **Compensation:**
$22\.50 per hour

 **Responsibilities:*** Utilize scripts to handle difficult customer situations and bring them higher up, if necessary
* Ensure customer account information is up\-to\-date
* Create records of customer interactions and follow up to ensure all questions have been answered
* Keep customer satisfaction levels high by providing accurate information, resolving issues, and mitigating complaints
* Assist operations staff by contacting clients via phone and email to request and receive the required paperwork and other documentation that supports our projects
* Facilitate meetings, Zoom calls, and conference calls with clients and provide follow\-up emails summarizing those interactions

 **Qualifications:*** Display strong communication skills, active listening skills, and personal skills
* Experience working in a customer\-oriented atmosphere


* Ability to convey professionalism via phone and email
* Superior organizational skills to monitor the status of several different projects
* Work well with others and be a team player
* Intermediate skills with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Word, PowerPoint, and Excel)
* Prior administrative experience in the accounting, tax, or consulting industries a plus
* Ability to prioritize and meet deadlines in a corporate environment
* BA/BS preferred

 **About Company** **Agile’s Purpose:**


We assist clients by aligning their tax and accounting systems with current sales \& use tax laws. That enables them to either maximize the benefit of the exemptions for which they qualify or become and remain compliant with their ongoing sales \& use tax collection, reporting, and filing obligations.

**Agile’s Vision:**


To establish \& maintain a reputation with consumers for developing \& delivering the most innovative, personalized, and comprehensive sales and use tax solutions to clients.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Individual Benefits
jobs.description:
Description:  



**About Legacy Risk Solutions**


Legacy Risk Solutions is a leading independent insurance agency platform headquartered in Gainesville, Georgia. Through its growing network of agency partners across the Southeast, Legacy provides commercial insurance, employee benefits, personal insurance, and risk management solutions to businesses and individuals. Built on a people\-first culture rooted in integrity, growth, and partnership, Legacy combines local expertise with the strength and resources of a larger organization to deliver exceptional service and long\-term success for clients, employees, and agency partners.

**Position Summary**


Legacy Risk Solutions is seeking an experienced Individual Benefits Account Manager to join our growing team. This role is responsible for supporting and servicing clients with individual insurance and benefits needs, providing knowledgeable guidance throughout the application, enrollment, renewal, and ongoing policy service process.


The ideal candidate is a client\-focused insurance professional with strong knowledge of individual health and benefits products, carrier requirements, and enrollment processes. This individual serves as a trusted resource for clients, helping them understand their coverage options, navigate policy questions, and resolve service issues while maintaining strong relationships with carrier partners and internal teams.

**What You’ll Do**

* Manage and service a book of individual benefits clients throughout the policy lifecycle, including new enrollments, renewals, policy changes, and ongoing service needs.
* Assist clients in understanding available individual insurance options and identifying solutions that align with their coverage needs and circumstances.
* Prepare and review individual benefit quotes, applications, renewal information, and supporting documentation.
* Market and analyze available individual benefit products, coverage options, and rates across appropriate carrier partners.
* Explain plan benefits, premiums, deductibles, copays, coinsurance, networks, exclusions, and other important coverage provisions to clients.
* Coordinate new business applications and enrollments, ensuring required information and documentation are complete and submitted to carriers accurately and on time.
* Assist existing clients with annual renewals and evaluate alternative coverage options when appropriate.
* Monitor pending applications and enrollment activity and proactively follow up with clients and carriers to ensure timely completion.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Job Description:**


Sharecare is the leading digital health company that helps people – no matter where they are in their health journey – unify and manage all their health in one place. Our comprehensive and data\-driven virtual health platform is designed to help people, providers, employers, health plans, government organizations, and communities optimize individual and population\-wide well\-being by driving positive behavior change. Driven by our philosophy that we are all together better, at Sharecare, we are committed to supporting each individual through the lens of their personal health and making high\-quality care more accessible and affordable for everyone. To learn more, visit www.sharecare.com.


Sharecare is hiring a Social Media Manager and Content Creator for Sharecare and AskMD, our personal health guide that helps people go from “What’s wrong?” to “What do I do about it.” This is one role that blends two skill sets: you own the day\-to\-day strategy and operations of our social channels, and you are hands\-on creative who can shape, produce, and when it helps, appear in the content itself.


Looking for someone with real creative chops: a strong sense of story, an eye for what performs, and the ability to turn an idea into a finished post. You bring the strategy, the creative instincts, and the operational rigor, and we bring the platform, the production support, the budget, and the brand.

**About AskMD**


AskMD is a personal health guide from Sharecare. When something feels off, it helps people understand what is happening, what to do next, and where to go, with guidance based on them, their coverage, and their options. It offers guidance and clear next steps, not a diagnosis, and it never replaces a doctor.

**What you’ll do**

* Own the day\-to\-day management of Sharecare and AskMD’s social channels, including strategy, the content calendar, publishing, and platform\-native best practices across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube
* Concept, script, and produce recurring short\-form series built around everyday health moments, from myth\-busting to man\-on\-the\-street interviews and live event content
* Create content hands\-on: shoot, edit, write captions, and step in front of the camera when a moment calls for it
* Leverage artificial intelligence tools to automate and scale social media content creation and increase campaign efficiency.
* Coordinate with writers, producers, editors, and Atlanta collaborators to keep a fast, test\-and\-learn pipeline moving
* Manage community engagement: respond, moderate, and build relationships with the audience and with Atlanta creators, athletes, and partners
* Track performance against clear goals, report on what is working, and use insights to shape the content roadmap
* Support launches, live events, and collaborations across Atlanta sports, culture,, and wellness
* Route anything that touches health guidance through Sharecare’s brand and clinical review so content stays safe and on brand

**What we’re looking for**

* 3\+ years managing brand or creator social channels, with a track record of audience and engagement growth
* Hands\-on creative skills: you can concept, shoot, and edit short\-form video, and you are comfortable on voice or camera when the content needs it
* Experienced with or open to AI\-assisted production tools
* Deep fluency in Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube: formats, trends, and what makes people stop scrolling
* A strong sense of story and voice, with a sharp eye for brand consistency
* Strong project management skills, comfortable coordinating talent, and contributors on tight timelines
* An analytical mindset: you set goals, read the numbers, and act on them
* Based in Atlanta and plugged into the city’s culture, sports, and events
* Comfortable with a fast, iterative pace
* Interest in health and wellness a plus (no medical background required, we have the clinicians)

**A few ground rules**


This is health\-adjacent entertainment, not medical advice. We keep it fun, and we never diagnose or play doctor. Anything that touches health guidance gets a look from Sharecare’s brand and clinical teams, so you can push creatively without worrying about the fine print.

**Details**


Full\-time position, part time in office in Atlanta, with a real budget for series, shoots, events, and collaborations. A key part of the corporate marketing organization and reporting to VP of marketing.


Sharecare and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers and E\-Verify users. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, equal pay, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or other status protected under applicable law.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Emerald**


Emerald’s talented and experienced teams grow our customers’ businesses 365 days a year with products that create connections, deliver content, and drive commerce. We produce over 140 annual events, create and deliver content through print and digital channels, and power commerce through our seamlessly integrated in\-person and digital platforms and channels. For more information, please visit http://www.emeraldx.com.

  

Emerald is looking for a high\-energy Business Development pro to help grow revenue across our portfolio of trade shows and conferences. You’ll be the person who finds the right companies to talk to, starts the conversation, and qualifies opportunities for our Account Executives to close.

  

If you like digging into research, testing what messaging works, and using tools like Gong and Salesforce to build a pipeline, you’ll fit right in. You’ll help create pipeline through modern outbound prospecting — combining research, signal\-based targeting, and consultative outreach. This is a fast\-paced, “learn by doing” role with clear coaching, measurable goals, and a strong path into an Account Executive career track. This role combines research, signal\-based targeting, and consultative outreach.

 **This position will be based out of our Alpharetta, GA or New York City, NY office.**

 **Why this role matters:** You’ll create the early\-stage pipeline—turning target accounts into real conversations and qualified opportunities that become pipeline and revenue.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Research net\-new exhibitor and sponsor accounts using ZoomInfo industry intelligence, and signal\-based prospecting (intent, trigger events, engagement signals).
* Build targeted lists and run multi\-threaded outreach cadences (email, phone, social) while keeping clean notes and next steps in Salesforce.
* Qualify prospects through short discovery conversations—understanding business pain, priorities, stakeholders, decisions process, and timing so we focus on high\-potential opportunities.
* Create personalized outreach that connects a prospect’s business goals to the value of Emerald’s events (ROI, audience, leads, brand visibility).
* Partner closely with Account Executives for a smooth handoff—sharing research, key contacts, conversation notes, and recommended next steps.
* Collaborate with Marketing and attendee teams to share feedback on lead quality, personas, and campaigns—then adjust targeting and messaging accordingly.
* Stay current on industry trends, competitor events, and emerging categories; bring new ideas for who we should be selling to next.
* Occasionally support the close by stepping in to run pricing/package conversations when needed.

**Qualifications:**

* 0–2 years of experience in sales, customer success, recruiting, fundraising, hospitality, or another role where you had to build relationships and hit goals (internships count).
* Comfortable with outbound outreach (calls \+ email) and willing to practice, iterate, and get better fast.
* Tech savvy: experience using Salesforce (or another CRM) and confidence learning new tools quickly.
* Organized and self\-directed—you can manage a daily outreach plan, follow\-ups, and deadlines without things slipping.
* Strong communication skills: you can write clear, professional messages and speak confidently with new people.
* Be a consultative partner. Apply structured discovery to understand business pain, priorities, stakeholders, and decision process.
* Ability to travel up to 30% (some events require on\-site time).

**Success Metrics:**

* You will be measured on pipeline created, qualified opportunities, conversion, target account penetration, activity effectiveness.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with Gong, ZoomInfo, sales engagement tools, or list\-building tools.
* Comfort with light data analysis (Excel/Google Sheets) to track activity and results.
* Interest in events, media, marketing, or B2B communities—and curiosity about how businesses grow.

 **What success looks like (first 90 days):**

**First 30 Days**  

Learn markets, messaging, systems, and outreach standards.

**60 Days**  

Consistently execute outbound cadence and generate qualified meetings.

**90 Days**  

Create repeatable pipeline contribution and begin influencing targeting and messaging.

 **About Emerald**


At Emerald, we strive to foster a diverse and inclusive community. We actively recruit and champion candidates who bring new perspectives from varied professional backgrounds and experiences, and we are intentional about ensuring a positive hiring experience for everyone. Our job postings don’t contain experience inflation, and most don’t require college degrees. Instead, they’re crafted to focus on outcomes and transferable experiences that are assessed in a structured interview process carried out by trained hiring teams.

 **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS**


Target Compensation: $60,000\-70,000 (Sales Incentive Eligible)


Please note that this range reflects a reasonable estimate of the target compensation for this position. This range may ultimately vary based on a candidate’s qualifications and may be higher where required by applicable law.

  

We offer a competitive benefits package designed to strengthen our employees’ physical and mental health, including unlimited vacation for exempt employees, flexible working locations, 401(k) plan with a company match, medical/dental/vision coverage with inclusive provisions including transgender services and fertility benefits, parental and caregiver leave, dependent, commuter and FSA benefits, professional development programs like Toastmasters, and mental wellness tools.

  

If you need accommodation in our application process or have questions about our posted salary range, please email our Talent Acquisition team at Careers@EmeraldX.com.

jobs.description:
Description:
**About Henricksen**


Henricksen (Oak Brook, IL) is a full\-service contract furniture dealership specializing in office, healthcare, education, government, senior living, and hospitality spaces. In 1962, Henricksen opened its doors as a small, family\-run dealership. Today, Henricksen is a leading national dealership with twelve offices in Illinois, Minnesota, New York, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Washington, DC and Wisconsin, 300\+ full\-time employees, and annual sales of $300\+ million. With 300\+ manufacturer partnerships, Henricksen offers an array of products from systems furniture, casegoods, seating, lounge, and conference furnishings to architectural solutions including modular walls, flooring, lighting, sound masking, and technology equipment. Henricksen is one of the largest privately\-owned dealer partners of HNI in the United States. HNI's furniture brands include Allsteel, Gunlocke, HBF, The HON Company, and Kimball International.

**Job Summary**


This position has the option to be working out of our Chicago, IL office or our Oak Brook, IL office. The Project Coordinator role serves as the main support to Account Executives and project team throughout the sales process. They will execute order management requirements for project as key collaborator across internal Customer Support team, vendors, and clients. While also acting as the central hub that drives overall quality of project delivery, engagement, outcomes, and services.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Project Relationship Management.** Engage and execute work as directed and in alignment with project role, accountabilities, and core process. Serve as liaison between Account Executive and cross\-functional team members (internal and external to the organization). Raise questions proactively to support and escalate issues as necessary.
* **Order Entry and Management.** Prepare quotes to clients using specification support software and with accurate vendor discounts and Account Executive markups applied. Place orders and maintain status reports. Maintain accountability for required client sign\-off verification's. Reconcile manufacturer acknowledgments and vendor invoices. Track product to designated location and schedule transactional deliveries. Stay connected with Account Executive, Designer, and Project Manager throughout the quote to order process.
* **Logistics and Issue Resolution.** Resolve punch\-list issues, file freight claims, and place orders for replacement products. Maintain project workbook to ensure ongoing order organization and real\-time communication. Identify and resolve issues related to service warranties.
* **Customer Service.** Maintain a professional and positive demeanor across situations, clients, and vendors. Communicate with transparency and professionalism across project team to promote exceptional client experience. Adapt to project and client needs in alignment with core process and service level expectations.
* **People and Culture Development.** Perform work and engage in support of organization culture and expectations. Establish and nurture inclusive relationships with colleagues and within project teams. Maintain accountability for ongoing learning and improvements required to perform job.


Requirements:
**Qualifications \- Education and Experience**

**Required:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required
* Proficient in Microsoft Office365 applications (including MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint)
* Ability to take direction
* Detail and task\-oriented with proven organizational and problem\-solving skills
* Work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven, and team environment
* Strong customer service and interpersonal orientation
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Strong ability and willingness for continued learning and professional development

**Preferred:**

* Knowledge working in IBM Quantum, CAP Quoting, and AS400 software programs are a plus
* Previous experience working in the contract furniture, design, or construction industries
* Exposure/Experience with bidding and quoting preferred
* Bachelor's or Associates degree in business, sales, design, real estate, construction or related field

**Additional Information**


Henricksen offers competitive wages based on skills and experience as well as comprehensive benefits packages. Henricksen is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are fully committed to cultivating a culture that is inclusive and integrates our Core Values in everything we do, every interaction we have, and every decision we make.

jobs.title: Program Specialist, Accessibility Services
jobs.description:
**POSITION**

The Program Specialist, Accessibility Services, supports the Chicago Housing Authority’s (CHA) centralized administration of reasonable accommodation requests for residents and applicants with disabilities. Under the direction of the Manager, Accessibility the Specialist serves as the primary intake and coordination with our service providers for reasonable accommodation requests, ensuring that all submissions are reviewed, verified, documented, and completed in accordance with Section 504, ADA, FHA, and CHA policy. This role requires a high level of attention to detail, strong communication skills, and the ability to guide residents, applicants, and property staff through the reasonable accommodation process with clarity, patience, and professionalism. The Specialist also contributes to broader Accessibility Services initiatives, including data tracking, resident support, and cross\-department collaboration.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


* Serve as the primary intake point for reasonable accommodation (RA) requests from public housing residents and applicants, ensuring timely review and processing.
* Complete assigned RA requests, including review of documentation, case notes, determination letters, resident notifications, and coordination with Service Providers, Property Management and other CHA departments.
* Conduct on ‑ site reasonable accommodation or modification assessments as needed to evaluate the feasibility of requested modifications, understand resident needs, and coordinate with Property Management and Maintenance teams.
* Ensure all RA determinations, correspondence, and supporting documentation are accurately recorded in YARDI and communicated to residents, applicants, and third\-party contractor staff. Prepare RA documentation and recommendations for approval chain.
* Communicate with residents and applicants regarding the status of their accommodation request, explaining processes, policies, and next steps in clear and accessible language.
* Coordinate implementation of approved accommodations with Property Management, Maintenance, Property Office/Occupancy, and other CHA partners.
* Participate in the interactive process when additional information, clarification, or consultation is required.
* Support special projects related to accessibility compliance, resident engagement, and quality\-of\-life initiatives as assigned.
* Travels to attend off\-site training, meetings, and events, as assigned;
* May be asked to handle tasks outside of job description to meet broader goals of CHA and Resident Services.
* This position requires working hours outside of CHA’s established hours of 8:30am – 5:00pm, Monday\- Friday including weekends.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

Bachelor’s degree in social work, public administration, disability studies, human development, liberal arts, or a related field, with a strong preference for candidates who have completed a graduate degree in disability studies, special education, public administration, public policy, or a similar discipline. Candidates should have at least one (1\) year of experience working with individuals with disabilities, providing coordination, supporting compliance or resident services, along with a demonstrated passion for public service and a commitment to advocating for people with disabilities. Experience within public housing or other regulated environments is beneficial. This role requires excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex policies in a clear and accessible manner, as well as strong organizational abilities to manage multiple cases and deadlines. Familiarity with disability rights laws such as Section 504, ADA, and the Fair Housing Act, is preferred, and a willingness to develop specialized expertise is essential. Proficiency in Microsoft Office is required, and experience with YARDI or other case management systems is a plus.  

***BENEFITS AT\-A\-GLANCE**** *Vacation, Sick and Personal, competitive PTO package*
* *Medical (HMO, PPO, and No employee cost High\-Deductible PPO) Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance*
* *Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Insurance*
* *Long\-Term Care Insurance*
* *Pet Insurance*
* *Parking Transit*
* *Prepaid Legal Services*
* *Brightstar 529 College Savings Plan*
* *Identity Theft Protection*
* *Hospital Indemnity Insurance*
* *Voluntary Critical Illness Insurance*
* *Deferred Compensation Plan: Empower 457/401(a) with a 3% employer match*
* *Pension Plan: CHA makes contributions on behalf of the employee, along with the employee's 3% contribution; 100% vesting occurs after 6 years of continuous employment or opt\-out of CHA's Retirement Plan and continues to participate in the Municipal Employees Annuity and Benefit Fund of Chicago*
* *Hybrid work schedule (position specific) This position may be eligible for remote work following a successful completion of a 90\-day probationary period according to CHA’s established policies and procedures.*

Salary Range: $60,000 ‐ $65,000
Grade: S7
FLSA: Exempt
Union: None

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
You get to create, execute, and keep the work moving.  

  

Roadrunner is the most tech\-forward company in LTL. We built a proprietary Smart Network™ that delivers fewer touches, faster transit, real\-time visibility, and real accountability. The service is differentiated. The point of view is clear. Marketing has not yet fully translated that advantage into how the brand shows up every day—on the website, in social, in video, in events, and in the materials our teams use.  

  

That’s the opportunity. Reporting to the Marketing Manager, you will be the creative force and operational backbone of the marketing team. You will design, film, write, organize, and ship. You will bring campaigns to life through compelling visual content, tight planning, and cross\-platform execution. You will keep initiatives on\-brand, on deadline, and running smoothly in a lean, PE\-backed environment that rewards ownership and speed.
**What you’ll do**
==================

**1\. Content Creation \& Brand Presence**
------------------------------------------


This is a creation role, not a maintenance role. You make the brand visible.

* Design and produce marketing materials using Canva and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro) for digital and print campaigns.
* Invent and ship high\-impact visual content that advances Roadrunner as the Category of One—graphics, sales collateral, social assets, landing\-page visuals, event materials, and campaign creative.
* Create video and photo content. Appear on camera when needed and direct shoots that capture authentic customer stories, owner\-operator voices, and company culture.
* Support Roadrunner’s LinkedIn and social presence with content that is sharp, human, and on\-brand—not generic freight marketing.
* Shape how the brand shows up across digital, physical, and experiential touchpoints so every interaction reinforces that Roadrunner is leading the way.

**2\. Campaign Execution \& Coordination**
------------------------------------------


The Marketing Manager owns the strategy. You make the machine run.

* Coordinate with vendors, internal stakeholders, sales, talent acquisition, and the marketing team to execute multi\-channel campaigns on time.
* Support integrated campaigns across digital, social, email, content, events, and emerging channels that drive awareness, pipeline, and talent outcomes.
* Treat every campaign as an experiment. Track what shipped, what worked, and what needs to change. Document what you learn.
* Produce materials and communications for strategic customer accounts based on direction from leadership and the Marketing Manager.

**3\. Website, Social \& Digital Presence**
-------------------------------------------


Keep the public face of the brand fresh, usable, and current.

* Manage and update the website CMS so content is accurate, optimized, and user\-friendly.
* Support social media content creation and campaign execution across platforms—planning, producing, scheduling, and reporting.
* Help build and maintain landing pages and digital experiences that match Roadrunner’s voice and convert attention into action.
* Use AI tools to accelerate production without sacrificing quality, voice, or point of view.

**4\. Calendar, Systems \& Operational Support**
------------------------------------------------


You are the detail\-oriented backbone. Nothing falls through the cracks.

* Own the marketing calendar and project\-management systems. Keep deadlines visible. Keep work moving.
* Help maintain reusable content resources, brand guidelines, and AI prompt frameworks so internal teams can produce on\-brand materials without bottlenecks.
* Apply AI and automation to recurring production and administrative work—reducing manual effort and shortening turnaround time.
* Track marketing expenses and assist with budget reconciliation.
* Identify friction in how marketing work gets done, then fix it with process, templates, and tools that stick.

**5\. Talent, Owner\-Operator \& Culture Content**
--------------------------------------------------


Attract the right people. Help them stay. Make the culture visible.

* Produce recruitment marketing creative that attracts high\-quality CDL drivers, owner operators, and key employees.
* Create targeted assets and content for owner\-operator acquisition and retention campaigns.
* Partner with talent acquisition and operations to support employee recruiting with clear, compelling materials.
* Capture and produce culture content—photos, video, recognition assets, newsletter visuals—that reinforces We Run Safe. We Run Smart. We Run Together.
* Support internal communications with polished, on\-brand assets so employees and owner operators feel informed and seen.

**What you bring**
==================

* Proven experience in a marketing or related creative role, with a portfolio that shows you can make work, not only talk about it.
* Significant creative skill in Canva and comfort in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro).
* Confidence both in front of and behind the camera for video and photography.
* CMS experience and proven website management skills.
* Event marketing experience, especially direct customer engagement and activation.
* Experience creating content for social platforms and running work across multiple channels at once.
* Detail\-oriented process and project\-management muscle. You keep calendars, files, vendors, and deadlines tight.
* Strong writing and visual storytelling. You can make industrial and technology stories feel sharp and human.
* Comfort using AI tools to create, iterate, and scale content without losing quality or brand voice.
* Comfort operating in a lean, fast\-moving environment where you wear multiple hats and invent process as needed.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Great to have: HubSpot or similar marketing automation, Google Analytics,

Job Summary:
  

  

The Epidemiology Research Coordinator II independently coordinates and executes large and moderately complex epidemiological, behavioral, or population health research studies. This role ensures protocol adherence, high\-quality data collection, and compliance with institutional and federal guidelines. The Epidemiology Research Coordinator II provides guidance and task support to less experienced staff and students, assists in refining operational workflows, and escalates complex issues to senior coordinators or investigators. Exemplifies the Rush mission, vision, and values and acts in accordance with Rush policies and procedures.


Required Job Qualifications:  

  



* Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Experience: 3 years of progressive research experience, including at least 2 years of experience coordinating human subjects' research

OR


Experience (in lieu of a degree): 5 years of progressively responsible research experience, including at least 3 years coordinating human subjects' research  

* 

  

Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities:


* Regulatory Knowledge – Applies working knowledge of Institutional Review Board (IRB) processes, Good Epidemiological Practice (GEP), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and Food and Drug Administration (FDA)/National Institutes of Health (NIH) regulations.
* Regulatory Compliance – Ensures protocol fidelity and implements study\-specific Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) with minimal supervision; independently prepares and manages IRB submissions.
* Regulatory Compliance – Follows established research procedures and maintains participant confidentiality.
* Project \& Time Management – Skill in coordinating concurrent timelines for recruitment, visits, reporting, and study close\-out.
* Problem\-Solving \& Judgment – Capacity to identify protocol deviations or field issues and resolve them with minimal oversight.
* Detail \& Organization – Competence in data organization, document tracking, and supply forecasting.
* Communication Skills – Ability to communicate clearly with participants, faculty, and staff.
* Computer Skills – Strong skills using the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and/or Google Suite.
* Teamwork – Capacity to lead task assignments and support the development of junior staff.
* Flexibility – Willingness to pivot across multiple studies and respond to time\-sensitive tasks.
* Travel Readiness – Flexibility to work off\-site or varied hours, with reasonable accommodations as needed.
* Scientific Literacy – Ability to interpret papers from scientific literature and apply findings to research workflows.
Other Duties as Assigned – Willingness to perform additional job\-related responsibilities as assigned by leadership.  
* 

  

Preferred Job Qualifications:


* Education: Master’s Degree in Public Health, Epidemiology, Health Sciences, or related field
* Experience: 4\+ years coordinating human subjects research studies
Experience: Independently managing IRB submissions  
* 

  

Job Responsibilities:  

  



* Participant Engagement:

* Coordinate participant recruitment, eligibility screening, informed consent, scheduling, follow\-up, and retention strategies with minimal oversight.
* Advise participant\-facing staff on participant communications to answer questions, address concerns, and reinforce study requirements.
* Collaborate with team members to evaluate and adjust recruitment approaches for assigned studies.
* Data Collection \& Entry:

* Implement accurate data collection procedures using approved electronic data capture systems to ensure timeliness, accuracy, and audit readiness.
* Independently review and reconcile collected data; analyze completeness and resolve discrepancies.
* Prepare and organize datasets for reporting or preliminary analysis by investigators or analysts.
* Protocol Implementation:

* Independently execute study procedures and visit workflows according to protocol milestones and operational checklists.
* Contribute to drafting, revising, and applying Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) with direction from the Principal Investigator or senior coordinators.
* Evaluate field or procedural issues, implement immediate corrective actions when appropriate, and document outcomes.
* Regulatory \& Compliance Tasks:

* Prepare and submit Institutional Review Board (IRB) applications, modifications, and continuing reviews with minimal oversight.
* Maintain organized, audit\-ready regulatory files that meet IRB, NIH, and institutional standards.
* Monitor assigned study activities for compliance with ethical and operational guidelines.
* Data Quality \& Preliminary Analysis:

* Assess data for accuracy and consistency; initiate corrective measures when discrepancies occur.
* Compile summary reports to inform progress tracking, internal reviews, or basic statistical summaries.
* Team Operations:

* Coordinate day\-to\-day assignments and onboarding for study staff to support timely task completion.
* Communicate project timelines, needs, and updates to leadership and collaborators.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

At Northwestern Medicine, every patient interaction makes a difference in cultivating a positive workplace. This patient\-first approach is what sets us apart as a leader in the healthcare industry. As an integral part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to join our quest for better health care, no matter where you work within the Northwestern Medicine system. We pride ourselves on providing competitive benefits: from tuition reimbursement and loan forgiveness to 401(k) matching and lifecycle benefits, our goal is to take care of our employees. Ready to join our quest for better?

 **Job Description**  

The **Administrative Coordinator** position reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.


The Administrative Coordinator is responsible for higher\-level administrative support to various directors within the organization and must use independent judgment and authority to execute projects and maintain workflow. The incumbent will work as part of team and demonstrate superior organization skills, strong interpersonal and communication skills, and attention to detail proficient Microsoft application skills (Word, Excel and PowerPoint) and be highly flexible and adaptable.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Independently performs high level technical and administrative work supporting the division or unit.
* Serves as a project manager for a variety of special projects; conducts special studies and analyses and makes recommendations to resolve organizational, procedural and system problems.
* Creates and revises systems and procedures by analyzing operating practices, record\-keeping systems, forms control, supplies inventory, and office layout.
* Implements changes independently for areas of responsibility. For issues outside responsibility, makes recommendations and, following managerial review, implements changes.
* Uses organizational software applications to research and prepare documents and presentations. Collects, analyzes, and manage data.
* Manages calendar; sets meeting priorities; identifies objectives of meetings and identifies materials needed for meeting; exercises judgment to ensure appropriate parties attend meeting.
* Screens incoming email, mail and telephone calls to assign priority, route as needed, identify additional resources needed to address and/or respond to the communication.
* Independently plans and executes events, activities, and meetings.
* Assists with creation, preparation, and distribution of materials to be presented to all levels of organizational staff.
* Reads, researches, and routes correspondence while maintaining security and confidentiality of highly sensitive information.
* Authors responses on behalf of director or department
* Develops and maintains relationships with all internal and external customers including patients, providers, staff and vendors.
* Records meeting discussions by attending meetings and recording key discussions and conclusions.
* May perform other duties as assigned.

  

**Qualifications** **Required****:**

* Associates Degree or equivalent relevant (administrative) experience
* 3\-5 years’ experience in a business office with a strong emphasis on database management and customer service.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office, PowerPoint and Excel.
* Ability to organize and think independently.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.

**Preferred****:**

* Bachelor of Arts degree or business equivalent.
* 5 years business experience.

  

**Additional Information**  

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

**Background Check**


Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check. Results are evaluated on a case\-by\-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

**Artificial Intelligence Disclosure**

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

**Benefits**


We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being while providing protection for unexpected life events. Please visit our Benefits section to learn more.

**Sign\-on Bonus Eligibility (if sign\-on bonus offered for position):** Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position at NM may be eligible depending upon the job family.

jobs.title: Group Sales Coordinator - The Ritz-Carlton
jobs.description:
**Why us?**

Iconic architecture, a thriving culinary scene, beautifully landscaped public spaces and an array of museums are just part of what draws visitors to the Windy City. At The Ritz\-Carlton, Chicago, a luxury hotel set atop Water Tower Place in the historic Gold Coast, guests will have every chance to explore the city, from shopping along Michigan Avenue to viewing famous works at the Art Institute. Yet with our hotel’s spa, rooftop lounge, locally inspired restaurant, indoor lap pool and spacious accommodations overlooking the city, guests may not want to leave the premises.


The Ladies \& Gentlemen in Salesare dedicated to creating meaningful relationships and delivering exceptional experiences for our guests and clients. As aGroup Sales Coordinator, you will provide essential support to the Group Sales team by coordinating sales activities, maintaining accurate client and group information, preparing proposals and correspondence, and assisting with the details that move each group from initial inquiry through arrival. You will communicate professionally with clients and internal partners while anticipating needs and ensuring that every detail is handled with care and precision. Working closely with Sales, Catering, Conference Services, Front Office and other hotel departments, you will help create a seamless experience that exceeds expectations and builds lasting client relationships.


Recognized as “the gold standard” of hospitality, The Ritz\-Carlton selects only the most passionate and skilled hospitality professionals. As one of our Ladies and Gentlemen, you will reflect the values that make us the world’s finest luxury brand. Here, in a diverse environment where individual aspirations are fulfilled and quality of life is enhanced, you will be inspired to work alongside your fellow employees to bring special moments to life for our guests and each other. Through your organization, attention to detail, responsiveness and commitment to excellence, you will play an important role in supporting our sales team, strengthening client partnerships and creating Ritz\-Carlton guests for life.


**Job Overview**

Assist sales managers in obtaining customer satisfaction by performing clerical and administrative duties relating to guest and hotel communications and sales. Responds to telephone and in\-person inquiries regarding reservations, hotel information and guest concerns.


**Responsibilities**

* Answer sales office phones when sales staff not available. Respond to all sales inquiries accurately, timely and in a professional manner.
* Type correspondence, reports and necessary forms i.e. contracts, as well as prepare proposals or other letters as directed.
* Coordination of all group and wedding business as contracted by the sales manager/DOS. Contact and provide appropriate follow\-up on all signed/contracted business within five (5\) working days. Determine and coordinate all needs of the customer.
* Responsible for effectively communicating with the various departments to ensure that the meeting and related functions are executed to exceed the client’s expectations.
* Account Service and Management: Maintains well documented, accurate, organized and up\-to\-date file management in order to serve client and employer in the most expedient, organized and knowledgeable manner.
* Develops strong customer relationships through appropriate client communication and the use of professional, courteous and ethical interpersonal interaction.
* Work with sales personnel to achieve required sales team goals.
* Have current knowledge of hotel rates, strategies, discounts and promotions.
* Assist with completing any required sales reports.
* Develop and effective communication and information system with the hotel team to disseminate details of upcoming group, meeting events and special events in the primary marketing area.
* Assist hotel with implementing hotel specific selling strategies.
* Promptly, the same day or by 10am the next business day, follows\-up on all customers’ needs and inquires in an efficient and expedient manner.
* Represents themselves and the hotel with the highest level of integrity and professionalism, a service focused approach and a caring, sincere attitude at all times.
* Exhibits a positive and involved team attitude to all hotel departments and maintains open communication with all co\-workers for the best overall performance of the hotel.
* Display a neat, clean and business\-like appearance at all times.
* Creates monthly social hour calendar with the Director of Sales.
* Assists the Sales department with monthly luncheons, client events, etc.
* Conduct walk\-in tours
* Create gift bags for guest traces, VIP’s, Hug’s, etc. Keep supplies stocked and on hand.
* Work with EBC on all group turnover and proper execution of the groups.

**Qualifications**

**Education/Formal Training**

High school diploma or vocational secretarial.


**Experience**

Previous sales, hospitality, and secretarial experience preferred.


**Knowledge/Skills**

* Advanced knowledge/use of Microsoft Word applications: Word, Excel, Publisher and PowerPoint.
* Alphabetizing, grammar and punctuation skills.
* Standard business letter formats.
* Strong editing skills.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


* Excellent communication skills necessary to communicate clearly with customers and other departments by phone or in person.
* Able to read contracts and letters.
* Able to use computers.
* Excellent attention to detail and multi\-tasking skills.
* Bending/kneeling \- repeated bending and kneeling required while filing
* Mobility \- must be able to reach all areas of hotel to assist clients. Occasional standing. Occasional carrying

* Energetic self\-starter with excellent written and oral communication skills

* Exceptional collaboration and teamwork skills

Delight is different to everyone. Whether it’s the perfect cup of coffee, or a water bottle that helps you crush your workout, our mission is to make it look great, function perfectly and cost less than you’d expect.

  

Delivering on this promise takes extraordinary efforts and exceptional people. Through our teams’ ingenuity and grit, we’ve created a place where the best ideas win, and they can come from anyone. Our culture combines the scrappy spirit of a startup with the perks of a market leader.

Together, we navigate each day with optimism, curiosity, a healthy sense of humor and a strong allergy to the word “no.” This desire for better, coupled with a deep understanding of consumers’ daily lives, gets us to meaningful delight.

As the day to day owner of Leapfrog's Walmart business, this role is responsible for delivering strong financial results while building a strategic partnership with Walmart's merchant, merchandising and replenishment teams. Our National Account Manager will leverage retail analytics (including Walmart Retail Link, Item 360 and Scintilla Charter), consumer trends, category insights, and customer knowledge to identify growth opportunities, optimize Leapfrog's assortment, improve operational execution, and enhance the in\-store and online shopper experience.

* Build a business strategy (alongside the Director of Sales) to meet and exceed annual budget goals, owning a budget number you're accountable to hit across channels and accounts, and pursuing new business/category opportunities as needed to help achieve those goals.
* Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact with Walmart's merchant and replenishment teams, supporting the Director of Sales in strengthening the account relationship and identifying category growth and new business opportunities.
* Manage and develop junior staff, coaching the team to execute against Leapfrog's annual sales budget goals.
* Serve as the voice of the account in cross\-functional planning with Channel/Marketing and Product Marketing, driving input into new product development and brand positioning to ensure alignment with account\-specific market dynamics.
* Develop strategic, tailored assortment plans spanning channels and multiple categories, focused on long\-term growth and maximizing sales.
* Lead day\-to\-day sales meetings and category business reviews including coordinating with the Director of Sales on executive\-level engagements and crafting personalized presentations and providing the materials needed to support them.
